title: Top Valorant Player Transfers 2027: Biggest Roster Moves in Current Transfer Window
content:
Following the conclusion of the season, the Valorant Esports transfer window is heating up as teams gear up for the 2027 VCT Season. The 2026 VCT Season closing on a tumultuous note for several top organisations has given us one of the most volatile transfer windows of all time. With surprising departures and notable additions, here are all the top transfers so far.

Arguably the biggest move of this transfer window, Sentinels have pulled in OXY from Cloud9 as part of their roster overhaul ahead of the upcoming season. Known for his aggressive plays, the duelist will be coming into the team as one of the most mechanically gifted talents on the scene right now, giving them the much-needed firepower they severely lacked in the last season.

The second exciting transfer also features Sentinels. Despite OXY headlining their transfer window, Zellsis and brawk will be the foundational players who will be tucked away from the limelight and into the supporting roles. Their exceptionally cerebral playstyles offer room for the big names to make their plays while providing the stability to close games.

The Asian powerhouse’s failure to produce any promising results in the last season led to the signings of MaKo from DRX and Dambi from Nongshim RedForce. The intention with these signings is readily apparent: to bolster their existing firepower and add the experience they need to take on the big names of the Valorant esports scene.

Meteor and TenTen, two prominent names from the Pacific region , have joined QT DIG, hoping to steer the ship in the right direction. With the moves made ahead of the last season failing to fill the tactical gaps within the roster, these two players were brought specifically to complement the team’s playstyle, with which the roster hopes to deliver better results in the upcoming season.

Prominent talents of the Valorant esports scene, Derke, Boo, and trexx, have joined Aurora to establish a dominant footprint in the MESA region with a high-profile squad. Derke, Boo, and trexx will now participate in the 2027 VCT Season in Aurora colours.

title: Jensen Huang Has Until 11 November to Answer Congress as China Calls the Spy Claims a Smear
content:
Jensen Huang has until Wednesday, 11 November, to tell three senior US lawmakers whether he will face them behind closed doors over his ties to a woman US intelligence has linked to Chinese espionage. The House committee chairs want the Nvidia chief executive in Washington on 18 November, one day after the company reports its quarterly results. Beijing, meanwhile, has dismissed the spy claims as a smear, and China’s state media has accused American outlets of building a thriller out of photographs and speculation. The two sides are now telling very different stories about the same affair.

The request was made before Huang admitted to the relationship, which has raised the stakes considerably. On Sunday, 8 November, he told Nvidia staff that he had been “unfaithful” to his wife, and the company’s board opened an independent investigation. Our explainer on the Megaspeed paper trail sets out how the case reached this point, from a Chinese gaming company’s offshoot to a year of warnings in Washington.

The letter , dated 4 November, is signed by Brian Mast of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, John Moolenaar of the Select Committee on the CCP and Rick Crawford of the House Intelligence Committee. All three are Republicans, and each chairs one of the committees involved. They ask Huang to appear for “a joint, closed-door briefing” in Room 2172 of the Rayburn House Office Building on 18 November. He must accept that date, or offer another session day, by 11 November.

The letter names two subjects for the session. The first is Nvidia’s security protocols against foreign espionage, and the second is Huang’s interactions with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom the chairs describe as “a publicly reported People’s Republic of China (PRC) intelligence asset”. The two Huangs share a surname but are not related. “It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk,” the chairs wrote, in a letter also published by the House China committee .

It is worth being clear about what this is. The letter is a request for a private briefing rather than a public hearing, so there will be no televised testimony if Huang attends. It is also not a subpoena, and it leaves room for him to suggest a different day within the current Congress, which ends in January. As of Nvidia’s last public comment on the request, the company had not said whether he would go.

The timing could hardly be more awkward for Nvidia. Huang is due to present the company’s third-quarter results on 17 November, just a day before the requested session. The chipmaker is also recovering from a sell-off in which it lost $450 billion in market value in a single day last week.

title: Jensen Huang Spy Scandal Explained: The Chinese Gaming Offshoot Washington Warned About for a Year
content:
Nvidia’s board is investigating chief executive Jensen Huang after he admitted to an extramarital affair, following reports that US intelligence linked him to a woman it believes was gathering information for China. The woman named in those reports, Alice Huang, was an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore chip buyer that was spun out of a Chinese games and cloud company. Megaspeed has been on the radar of US lawmakers, Commerce Department investigators and Singapore’s police for more than a year. That paper trail, much of it public since October 2025, explains why a personal scandal has turned into a national security question for the world’s most valuable chipmaker.

Huang addressed the reports in a letter to Nvidia staff on Sunday, 8 November, writing that he owed his family and colleagues an apology. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children,” he wrote, adding that there was “no excuse” for what he did. He did not name the person involved, and said he takes “full responsibility” while remaining committed to Nvidia.

The board said a committee of independent directors, working with outside counsel, will run the review. It said it has “no reason to believe” that national security or Nvidia’s secrets were compromised, and that Huang will keep leading the company while the investigation continues. Our first report on the board’s investigation covers Sunday’s announcement in detail.

It is worth separating what Huang has admitted from what has only been reported. Huang has confirmed the affair, but not who it was with. The link to Alice Huang comes from The New York Times, which reported that he acknowledged to the board an intimate relationship with a business executive. According to the Times, US intelligence determined that this executive was gathering information for Beijing, and the two are not related.

The espionage claim itself rests on US intelligence assessments described to reporters, and the evidence has not been made public. According to the Times, a memo circulated to Trump administration officials earlier this year said China’s Ministry of State Security had recruited Alice Huang to gather information on Nvidia’s chief executive. The Financial Times reported that the same memo described a romantic relationship. No charges against her have been reported, and TalkEsport could not find any public statement from her or from Megaspeed.

Beijing has rejected the allegations outright as a smear campaign. Foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said on Monday that “the so-called Chinese spy allegation is unsubstantiated”, calling it “nothing but smears against China”. Nvidia had previously described the pair’s interactions as “not unusual”, saying Huang meets thousands of customer executives every year and that the company does not share classified information with customers.

title: Valorant: Wo0t Returns to Turkey With FUT After Three Years at Heretics
content:
Wo0t, the Team Heretics flex player, signs with FUT Esports for the 2027 Valorant season and reunites with yetujey on the Turkish roster.

Mert "Wo0t" Alkan, a flex player who spent three years at Team Heretics, has signed with FUT Esports for the 2027 Valorant season, VLR.gg reported.

It is his first spell with a Turkish team since 2023.

FUT is one of eight partner teams in EMEA for 2027 and one of two partnered Turkish organisations, alongside BBL Esports. That status already guarantees the team a place in the VCT 2027: EMEA Kickoff.

title: IEM Beijing tops Bucharest’s peak without help from the final
content:
FURIA’s quarter-final exit against BetBoom drew Beijing’s biggest single audience, while MOUZ’s 54-round sweep of The MongolZ missed the top five.

IEM Beijing 2026 peaked at 720,859 concurrent viewers, according to Esports Charts , about 52,000 more than PGL Masters Bucharest managed a week earlier. The grand final played no part in it. MOUZ ‘ 3-0 win over The MongolZ on Sunday is not among the event’s five most-watched series.

The peak came on Wednesday 4 November, the last day of the group stage, when MongolZ against FURIA and NAVI against Team Falcons were on air at the same time. No single series reached that figure on its own.

The most-watched series of the week was FURIA against BetBoom Team in the quarter-finals on Friday, which peaked at 608,868. It was also the end of FURIA’s event: BetBoom finally got the better of them 2-1, with zorte on 62-36.

NAVI appeared in each of the next four. Their group stage loss to FURIA on Tuesday peaked at 517,693. The win over Falcons on Wednesday followed with 491,279.

That leaves the final somewhere below 447,246. MOUZ were not involved in any of the top five, even on their way to the title. The final started at 15:30 local time in Beijing, which was 08:30 CET on a Sunday morning in Europe.

title: Patch 13.10 leak points to Sentinel buffs for Cypher, Killjoy, Vyse and Sage
content:
Three Sentinels would get their gadgets back faster after losing them, while Sage’s Healing Orb gets easier to aim.

Valorant patch 13.10 will bring buffs to four Sentinels, according to a leak posted on Saturday by dataminer valohabercisi. Riot has not published the patch notes, so the changes are unconfirmed and could still be altered before release.

[LEAK] Patch 13.10 Coming with some sentinel buffs next week ●Cypher Spycam Cooldown of reclaim has been increased from 15s to 20s. Cooldown after destroy has been decreased from 60s to 45s. ● Killjoy Turret Cooldown after destroy has been decreased from 60s to 45s. ●… pic.twitter.com/9lBabMZfsW

The common thread is the 60s to 45s cut. Destroying a Spycam, Turret or Arc Rose is how attackers clear a Sentinel’s setup, and a shorter wait means it comes back sooner in the next fight. Cypher pays for his part with a slower reclaim, which hurts players who pick the camera up and move it mid-round.

Sage’s change is a quality-of-life fix rather than a power boost. No numbers were leaked for her.

It would follow June’s patch 13.00 , which buffed Cypher, Killjoy, Sage, Veto and Deadlock. The leak says 13.10 is due next week. The most recent update was patch 13.09 on 27 October.

title: BC.Game become GOSH and 1win THE ONE for the Singapore Major
content:
PGL’s official team graphics for Singapore confirm that four teams with betting brands in their names will play under new ones, and only two of them get a new logo.

s1mple’s BC.Game will play the PGL Major Singapore as GOSH. PGL revealed the names and logos of all 32 teams on X on Monday at 09:01 CET , and four sides from the betting industry appear under new names: BC.Game as GOSH, 1win as THE ONE, BetBoom as BB Team and PARIVISION as PVISION.

🏆 PGL Major Singapore 2026 🇸🇬 – Stage 1, 2, and 3 teams. 🎟️ Tickets: https://t.co/gJ4XqKXuvc #PGLMajor pic.twitter.com/3gOzSvJ6Pj

GOSH and THE ONE come with new logos. BB Team and PVISION keep the symbols fans already know and only lose the betting brand from the name, as NarT pointed out in his side-by-side of the old and new branding.

No other team has a new name. The other 28 appear as they usually do, and one sponsor survives: 9z are listed as “9z Globant”, since Globant is a software company and not a betting brand. Imperial, whom Dust2.us had also named because of their Gamdom sponsorship, are simply “Imperial Esports”.

As we reported on Saturday , Singapore law does not allow unlicensed gambling brands to be promoted at events, and Singapore Pools is the only operator licensed for online betting in the country. BC.Game chief executive Ali “Ako” Muhanned confirmed then that his team could not use its name or logo and had sent PGL and Valve an alternative. Monday’s graphics show which names were approved.

title: GTA 6 Cheat Codes for PS5 and Xbox: Are There Any Yet?
content:
There are no confirmed GTA 6 cheat codes yet. Rockstar Games has not published a single cheat for PS5 or Xbox, and it has not said whether the game will have cheats at all. Any list you see online right now, with button combinations for weapons, cars or wanted levels, is guesswork at best and made up at worst.

That will change when GTA 6 launches on November 19. Until then, here is what we actually know, how cheats worked in GTA V, and how to avoid the fake lists and scams that are already doing the rounds.

Nobody outside Rockstar knows for sure. The developer has not mentioned cheats in any trailer, store listing or official post, and none of the game’s pre-release coverage has shown them in action.

History is on the side of fans, though. Cheat codes have been part of nearly every mainline GTA game, from the 3D era through to GTA V, and Red Dead Redemption 2 had them too. It would be a surprise if Rockstar dropped them completely, but until the game is out, it is not confirmed.

GTA V is the best guide to what GTA 6 might do. It gave players three ways to enter cheats.

Cheats in GTA V also came with rules. You could still save your game with a cheat active, but trophies and achievements were turned off while it was in use, according to Rockstar Support . Entering a code again usually switched the cheat off, and reloading a save cleared them all.

title: Is GTA 6 Online Coming Soon? What the Leaked PS5 Data Actually Shows
content:
GTA 6’s PlayStation 5 files contain the first hints of online play. With pre-loading about to begin, the tracking account PlayStation Game Size has found three multiplayer-related entries tied to GTA 6 in Sony’s backend data, and fans are now asking whether GTA 6 Online could arrive sooner than expected.

It is an exciting find, but it is also a small one. The entries show that GTA 6 is set up to support online activities on PS5. They do not tell us what the online mode is called, what it includes, or when it will launch, and Rockstar has still not said a word about it.

PlayStation Game Size, which tracks game listings and file data on Sony’s systems, shared three “activity” entries linked to GTA 6.

Grand Theft Auto VI supports : intentType": "joinSession" intentType": "launchActivity" intentType": "launchMultiplayerActivity"

Activities are a PS5 feature that let you jump straight into a mode or mission from the console’s home screen. The multiplayer entry is the interesting one, since it suggests GTA 6 will have online content that the PS5 menu can launch. As VGTimes put it in its report, “The data doesn’t confirm that online play will be available at launch.”

The same data lists the current version as 01.001.004, with a worldwide PS5 package of about 223GB. That sits between the 212GB in Rockstar’s official FAQ and the 230GB printed on the PS5 boxes already reaching stores .

title: GTA 6 Has a Real Racetrack, a Mud Club and Streets Made for Supercars
content:
GTA 6 is shaping up to be the most car-friendly game Rockstar has made. Footage released ahead of launch shows a proper circuit race with a lap counter and timer, Rockstar has confirmed an off-road Mud Club in the swamps of Ambrosia, and Leonida’s coastline looks built for long drives in fast cars.

If you mostly play GTA to drive, here is where you will want to head first when the game launches on November 19, based on what Rockstar has actually shown.

The biggest surprise is a wheel-to-wheel race on what looks like a closed road course, complete with a lap counter and timer on screen. Earlier GTA games had street races and stunt tracks, but a dedicated circuit would be a first for the main series, as HotCars points out in its breakdown.

Rockstar has not named the track or said where it is. Some fans believe it sits near Port Gellhorn and takes inspiration from Sebring International Raceway, the Florida circuit famous for its 12-hour endurance race. That would fit a game set in a version of Florida, but for now it is a fan theory, not a confirmed detail.

Away from the city, Rockstar has confirmed the Thrillbilly Mud Club, based in Ambrosia, the rural sugar-refining region of Leonida. Mud trucks, lifted builds and swamp racing look set to be a big part of life out there.

Ultimate Edition owners get extra here. That version includes access to One-Eyed Willie’s, an off-road shop on Lake Leonida, and the ’67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, which Rockstar describes as a “Mud Club monster”. The Dominator has long been GTA’s take on the Ford Mustang, so this is effectively a first-generation Mustang turned into a mud-slinging buggy.

title: FFWS 2026 Global Finals Knockout Phase 1 Week 1 Results
content:
Free Fire World Series (FFWS) Global Finals 2026 Phase 1 concluded on Sunday, November 8, with P Esports topping the overall standings with 325 points in 18 matches, followed by Fluxo W7M and Team Flash. India teams Team Apex Gaming and Resurrection have performed well in the first week, while TSG Pros is currently in the danger zone.

Based on the Phase 1 overall standings, the top 20 teams will be seeded in various pools for Phase 2, while the remaining four teams will be eliminated from the tournament. However, one more week is pending in Phase, which will be played from 13 to 15 November. After that, the seeding will be done.

As of now, Team Apex Gaming is in a good position after securing 12th place with 210 points. The team will try to be in the top 12 for the next week, as well as the top 12 teams will be seeded in Pool 2 for Phase 2, where they will get some advantage.

Resurrection also played well. They started slow, but once they get the momentum, they will be very good. The team is currently sitting in 14th place with 183 points with 1 Booyah.

However, TSG Pros are in a danger zone. Despite taking one Booyah, the team is sitting at 21st place with 122 points. Remember that the bottom 4 teams will be eliminated from the tournament after Week 2.

The FFWS 2026 Knockout Stage Phase 1 Week 2 will be played from 13 to 15 November. The groups will play 18 more games each, and after all games, the seeding will be decided on the basis of overall standings.

title: Nvidia Probes Alleged Chinese Spy Ties to Jensen Huang
content:
Nvidia’s board announced that it is opening an independent investigation after reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the review.

The board said the inquiry will examine all available information. It also said it has confidence in Huang and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate.

The board said Huang supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it.

In his message, Huang said he was unfaithful to his wife and that his actions hurt her and their children. He said he took full responsibility and had fallen short of his duties to Nvidia’s employees, board, and shareholders.

Huang also said he is fully committed to Nvidia and will work to earn back the confidence of the company. The message did not name the woman involved.

title: Valve Paid More Tax in Kazakhstan Than Apple and Google, Helped by Russian Steam Users
content:
Valve paid more VAT in Kazakhstan than Apple, Google or any other foreign digital company in the first half of 2026. Steam’s owner paid about 11.21 billion tenge in value-added tax over those six months, ahead of Temu, Apple and Google Play, according to a ranking reviewed by tax expert Dmitry Kazantsev for the Kazakh outlet Digital Business.

Part of the reason sits across the border. For several years, players from Russia have been moving their Steam accounts to the Kazakhstan region, and the VAT on their purchases now counts towards Kazakhstan’s total.

The figures cover VAT paid by foreign digital companies registered in Kazakhstan between January and June 2026. To show what each payment means in sales, we also worked out the implied spending, including tax, using Kazakhstan’s standard 16% VAT rate.

Kazantsev put Valve’s implied figure at around 81.3 billion tenge, and our calculation matches it. In plain terms, Steam users in Kazakhstan spent more on games, DLC and marketplace items in six months than they spent through Apple’s App Store in the same period. That is a striking result for a country of around 20 million people.

It is also notable for how far ahead of Google Play Steam sits. Valve paid more than double Google’s VAT, even though Android phones are far more common than gaming PCs.

According to iXBT.games, which reported the ranking, Russian gamers have been actively switching their Steam accounts to the Kazakhstan region in recent years, and their spending helped push Valve to the top.

title: GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements: How Many There Are and Why the List Is Still Hidden
content:
Rockstar Games has not released the GTA 6 trophy and achievement list, and with ten days to go before launch, that is unusual. The only number doing the rounds is an unconfirmed report of 55 trophies, made up of 54 regular trophies and one platinum on PS5, or a top-tier achievement on Xbox.

Here is what is known, what is still only a claim, and how GTA 6 compares with Rockstar’s past games.

There is no official answer yet. The 55 figure comes from the fan account GTAVI_Countdown, which posted it on November 7 and credited an unnamed source. No trophy names, descriptions or Gamerscore values have been shared, and neither Rockstar nor Sony or Microsoft has confirmed it.

If the count is right, it is a little higher than Rockstar’s recent games, but in the same range. Most big open-world titles land somewhere between 40 and 60 trophies.

On Xbox, the top reward could be one of Microsoft’s new Mythic achievements, the rare tier with its own symbol and unlock sound. We explained how Xbox Mythic achievements work when Microsoft revealed them. Rockstar has not confirmed GTA 6 will use one.

Rockstar used to be open about trophies. It published achievement lists on its Newswire for Red Dead Redemption, L.A. Noire and Max Payne 3, each more than a month before launch. For its two biggest games since then, the lists never came from Rockstar at all. GTA V’s list surfaced unofficially about a month before release in 2013, and Red Dead Redemption 2’s appeared on PSNProfiles around two weeks before launch, according to a timeline compiled by fan site GTAVice.

title: LFL : courtisé en LEC, Looki reste fidèle à la Karmine Corp
content:
La Karmine Corp continue de construire son effectif académique pour la saison prochaine. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Rocco « Looki » Palfi devrait prolonger son aventure avec la Karmine Corp Blue, malgré l’intérêt suscité par ses performances en LFL. Le joueur allemand avait notamment participé aux essais organisés par Vitality pour son équipe LEC, une opportunité qui l’avait poussé à repousser les discussions concernant son avenir. Mais après avoir tenté sa chance au plus haut niveau européen, l’ADC devrait finalement rester fidèle au Blue Wall pour une saison supplémentaire.

Arrivé au sein du projet Blue Stars à l’intersaison précédente, Looki avait rapidement fait ses preuves en remportant la Nexus League. Ses performances lui avaient permis d’être promu dans l’équipe LFL au cours du Spring Split, en remplacement de Hazel, après un début de saison compliqué pour la formation française. Un changement qui s’est révélé payant : avec le jeune Allemand sur la botlane, la KC a notamment atteint les quarts de finale des EMEA Masters à deux reprises, tout en décrochant la troisième place du Summer Split de LFL. Une progression encourageante pour un joueur qui découvrait encore récemment ce niveau de compétition.

Le maintien annoncé de Looki confirme la volonté de la Karmine Corp de capitaliser sur son centre de formation. Lancée en 2025, l’équipe Blue Stars a déjà permis à plusieurs jeunes joueurs de franchir un cap vers la scène professionnelle. Deux autres talents issus de cette structure devraient d’ailleurs être promus en LFL pour la saison 2027 : le jungler Oleg et le midlaner Panda, dont les arrivées avaient déjà été révélées par Sheep Esports . Looki retrouverait ainsi deux anciens coéquipiers avec lesquels il avait évolué en Nexus League.

L’effectif de la Karmine Corp Blue prend donc progressivement forme. Tao devrait conserver sa place sur la toplane, tandis qu’Oleg, Panda et Looki occuperaient respectivement les postes de jungler, midlaner et ADC. Seul le poste de support resterait encore à pourvoir, plusieurs pistes étant actuellement étudiées par les dirigeants. Après une saison 2026 marquée par deux qualifications en quarts de finale des EMEA Masters, la formation française espère désormais franchir un nouveau palier. Et avec un effectif largement issu de sa propre académie, la Karmine Corp semble déterminée à prouver que son projet de formation peut aussi produire des résultats au plus haut niveau des ligues régionales.

title: Solary va ramener une pépite de T1 en LFL
content:
Solary prépare un nouveau gros coup sur le mercato. D’après les informations de Sheep Esports , Kim « Cypher » Yu-jun devrait rejoindre la formation française pour la saison 2027, après plus de trois années passées au sein des équipes académiques de T1. Né en Italie, où il a vécu pendant dix ans, le joueur sud-coréen s’apprête à découvrir la scène compétitive européenne pour la première fois. Un recrutement ambitieux pour Solary, qui entend confirmer son nouveau statut parmi les meilleures équipes des ligues régionales européennes.

Passé par les différentes équipes de jeunes de T1, Cypher avait intégré à temps plein l’effectif de T1 Academy en LCK Challengers League cette année. En 2026, il a disputé 110 rencontres officielles, avec un taux de victoire de 61,8 %, se distinguant notamment sur Kai’Sa (9 victoires pour 1 défaite) et Varus (7 victoires pour 1 défaite). Malgré ces performances encourageantes, l’ADC avait perdu sa place en fin de saison au profit d’Eclipse, jeune talent de 17 ans. Ce dernier avait notamment participé au World Star Challengers Invitational, remporté par T1 Academy face à… Solary. Cypher pourrait donc retrouver certains de ses anciens coéquipiers dès l’année prochaine, mais cette fois sous les couleurs françaises.

Ce recrutement s’inscrirait dans la continuité d’une saison exceptionnelle pour Solary. Après plusieurs années sans parvenir à se qualifier aux EMEA Masters, la structure a remporté son premier titre européen lors de l’édition Winter 2026, avant de décrocher deux sacres consécutifs en LFL. Finaliste des EMEA Masters au Spring puis au Summer, ainsi que du WSCI, l’équipe tourangelle s’est imposée comme l’une des références de la scène européenne de deuxième division. Des résultats qui lui permettent désormais d’afficher de grandes ambitions pour 2027.

L’arrivée annoncée de Cypher constituerait une nouvelle étape dans la reconstruction de l’effectif. Solary aurait déjà trouvé un accord verbal avec Boukada, ancien jungler de SK Gaming et Shifters en LEC. Le reste de l’équipe demeure toutefois incertain, plusieurs joueurs explorant actuellement leurs possibilités au plus haut niveau européen, tandis que les contrats de l’effectif actuel arrivent prochainement à expiration. Avec deux recrues prometteuses et des moyens financiers importants à l’échelle des ligues régionales, Solary semble déterminée à rester au sommet. Et pourquoi pas prendre sa revanche sur T1 lors d’une prochaine confrontation internationale ?

title: Jynxzi launches his esports team, signs R6 roster: Who are the players and what’s next?
content:
At the beginning of November 2026, Nicholas “Jynxzi” Stewart made a big announcement via a seemingly casual tweet. He wrote, “Introducing Jynxzi Esports,” and tagged five Rainbow Six players. It was the reveal of his own esports organization.

The official R6 Esports account made their move as well, crafting a welcoming poster confirming that Jynxzi Esports is stepping into this competitive scene.

title: LCS : après le fiasco des Worlds, Tactical va quitter Cloud9 ?
content:
Le mercato s’annonce particulièrement agité du côté de Cloud9. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Edward « Tactical » Ra aurait reçu l’autorisation d’explorer ses options pour la saison 2027, malgré un contrat jusqu’au 20 novembre 2028. La structure nord-américaine aurait en parallèle commencé à étudier plusieurs pistes pour renforcer sa botlane. Un départ de Tactical est donc désormais envisageable, même si aucune décision définitive n’aurait encore été prise. En raison de sa situation contractuelle, un éventuel transfert nécessiterait notamment un accord entre les différentes parties.

Arrivé chez Cloud9 le 25 juin dernier, Tactical avait pourtant contribué au renouveau de l’équipe durant le Summer Split. Tout juste sacré champion de la NACL avec Conviction, l’ADC avait été recruté pour concurrencer le vétéran Zven, dans un contexte particulièrement difficile pour la formation américaine. Après huit échecs consécutifs lors de matchs qualificatifs pour les compétitions internationales, Cloud9 cherchait désespérément à retrouver les sommets. Le pari avait finalement porté ses fruits : Tactical s’était imposé comme titulaire, tout comme le midlaner Loki à la place d’APA. Troisième du Summer Split après une défaite contre LYON (1-3), Cloud9 avait ainsi décroché sa première qualification aux Worlds depuis deux ans.

Mais le retour sur la scène internationale a rapidement tourné au cauchemar. Éliminé dès le 16 octobre après une défaite contre les Brésiliens de FURIA (1-3), Cloud9 est devenu la première équipe à quitter les Worlds 2026. Il s’agit même de l’élimination la plus précoce de l’histoire de l’organisation dans la compétition. Une contre-performance particulièrement difficile à digérer, qui avait notamment poussé le support Vulcan à qualifier publiquement les prestations de son équipe de « pathétiques » .

La direction semble désormais déterminée à repartir sur de nouvelles bases. Le contrat de Zven a déjà été résilié, tout comme celui d’APA, tandis que l’avenir de Tactical reste incertain. Plusieurs ADC de renom pourraient d’ailleurs être disponibles sur le marché nord-américain dans les prochaines semaines. Berserker, Massu, Yeon et sajed arrivent notamment à l’échéance de leurs contrats respectifs, offrant à Cloud9 plusieurs possibilités pour reconstruire sa botlane. Après avoir retrouvé les Worlds en 2026, la structure américaine espère surtout éviter une nouvelle désillusion internationale l’année prochaine.

title: Worlds 2026 : la Karmine Corp fait exploser les audiences face à T1
content:
La Karmine Corp a quitté les Worlds 2026, mais elle aura marqué cette édition jusque dans les chiffres d’audience. Opposée au triple champion du monde en titre T1, la formation française a attiré une foule impressionnante de spectateurs dans la nuit de vendredi à samedi. Selon les données publiées par Esports Charts , le quart de finale a enregistré un pic de 2 793 144 spectateurs simultanés, hors plateformes chinoises. Un record pour cette édition 2026, qui n’avait encore jamais franchi la barre des deux millions de spectateurs sur une même rencontre.

Un engouement qui s’explique autant par la popularité mondiale de T1 et de Faker que par l’immense communauté de la Karmine Corp. Pour sa première participation aux championnats du monde, le club français avait réussi à se hisser jusqu’en quarts de finale après un parcours commencé dès le Play-In. Malgré une troisième manche remportée par les coéquipiers de Caliste, les Coréens ont finalement imposé leur supériorité, notamment grâce à un Peyz exceptionnel. Une élimination douloureuse pour le dernier représentant européen, mais qui n’a pas empêché les supporters du Blue Wall de répondre massivement présent.

Sur Twitch, Kameto a lui aussi vécu une soirée historique. Le cofondateur de la Karmine Corp a rassemblé jusqu’à 262 641 spectateurs simultanés sur sa chaîne, établissant un nouveau record personnel pour une rencontre de League of Legends. Une performance qui témoigne de l’engouement suscité par le parcours de la KC, capable de mobiliser une communauté considérable face à l’une des équipes les plus prestigieuses de l’histoire de l’esport.

À l’échelle internationale, ce quart de finale a largement dominé les autres affiches du tournoi, aucune des trois autres rencontres de ce stade n’ayant intégré le top 5 des matchs les plus regardés de l’édition. Le pic reste toutefois inférieur aux 3,92 millions de spectateurs enregistrés lors du quart de finale entre T1 et Anyone’s Legend en 2025. Avec ses 2,79 millions de spectateurs, les Worlds 2026 se hissent néanmoins à la quatrième place des événements esportifs les plus suivis de l’année, dépassant notamment le Major d’IEM Cologne sur Counter-Strike 2. Et les chiffres pourraient encore grimper : T1 retrouvera Bilibili Gaming ce dimanche en demi-finale, avant une grande finale programmée le 14 novembre.

@T1LoL vs @KarmineCorp reached 2.79M Peak Viewers! The most popular match of Worlds 2026 so far, and the first to surpass 2M viewers Full breakdown: https://t.co/PxqFCK1ISd pic.twitter.com/CE9KUqlUP9

title: Apex Legends Cipher: everything new in Season 31
content:
A rewired Crypto, a second Wingman in your off hand and the first Legend bans in Ranked headline a season built around information and control.

Apex Legends Season 31, Cipher, went live on 3 November 2026. EA published the full patch notes a day earlier, and this guide collects every change that matters in one place: the Crypto rework, Akimbo Wingman, the returning Hemlok Burst AR, Strongholds, Legend bans, the Ranked changes and the maps in rotation.

We keep it updated through the season. For where every Legend and weapon stands after the patch, see our Legend tier list and weapon tier list .

Crypto is the face of the season, and his kit has been rebuilt around a drone that hunts for information rather than parks in a corner. EA’s lore framing is a firmware upgrade from his sister Mila. In practice it means this:

His upgrades change as well. Got Eyes On You replaces Ally.MoveTo at level 2, and Charged Up, which adds 10 seconds of battery, replaces Hackathon at level 3. Crypto also gets the season’s Mythic, Cryptic Core, a Volt SMG in his colours.

The Wingman can now be dual wielded. Loot a second Wingman and you enter Akimbo mode automatically. In Akimbo the pistols fire in quick bursts, and holding the trigger repeats them.

title: New Microsoft Patent Could Use AI to Change What People Say in Live Video
content:
Microsoft has filed a patent for an AI system that can change what people say in live video and redraw their lip movements to match, in near real time. The application, published at the end of October, describes software that picks out words, swaps them for new ones, and generates fresh video frames so the speaker’s mouth looks like it said the replacement all along.

The edits would not be the same for everyone. According to the filing, the system tailors changes to each viewer’s profile, including their age, location and languages. In other words, two people watching the same live broadcast could hear two different versions of it.

The patent was first spotted by patent tracker Patentlyze . Based on its breakdown, the process has three stages. First, the system scans live video and audio. Next, an AI agent decides which words to change for a given viewer. Finally, a generative AI model replaces the audio, smooths over the edit and generates new frames of the speaker’s mouth so the picture matches the sound.

The filing calls this “near-real-time”, which Patentlyze takes to mean a delay of a few seconds. It says the system could run on phones, tablets, cameras and AR glasses.

Some of the proposed uses are harmless. Others are the kind that make people nervous about AI-edited video.

Live translation is the most obviously useful idea. Watching a speech or stream in a language you do not speak, with the speaker appearing to talk in yours, would be a genuine accessibility win. Instant fact-checking, by contrast, raises a harder question: who decides what the “correct” version of someone’s words is?

title: Riot Disqualifies Team BONK for Cheating in VCT EMEA Kickoff Qualifier, Orders Rare Replays
content:
Riot Games has disqualified Team BONK from the VCT EMEA Kickoff Europe Qualifier 1 after its anti-cheat team confirmed that a member of the team was using cheating software. Every player and registered team member has been provisionally suspended from Riot-sanctioned competitions while the investigation into individual involvement continues. Riot announced the decision on the VCT EMEA account on 8 November, and ordered two rounds of the bracket to be replayed the same day. The announcement had passed 140,000 views within an hour.

Competition Update: BONK, Kickoff Europe Qualifier #1 pic.twitter.com/gqnNRxOhiu

According to Riot, its anti-cheat team has been reviewing matches throughout the Kickoff Qualifiers to look for potential cheating. Suspicious behaviour involving BONK was reported during Qualifier 1, and a further investigation “confirmed that a participant on Team BONK was using unauthorised cheating software”. Riot stressed that the suspensions are interim measures, and that any final sanctions will depend on what it finds for each individual. It also restated its “zero-tolerance policy for cheating, including knowingly enabling, assisting or concealing cheating by others”.

The disqualification came late in the tournament, which is why Riot had to rewrite part of the bracket. BONK had won their first three matches 2-0, against Educated Idiots, Mörköjengi and THE ONE, before knocking out Aurora Gaming, Project 100K and YCATBLE in turn. That run had taken them into a semi-final against Pixel Lumina, which was due to be played on Sunday. Instead, Riot has decided to replay the two rounds that followed BONK’s win over Aurora.

All three affected teams agreed to play again on 8 November. Aurora Gaming face Project 100K in the round of 16 at 17:00 CET, and the winner meets YCATBLE in the quarter-finals at around 19:30 CET. That quarter-final decides a place in the Kickoff Europe Qualifier playoffs. The semi-final against Pixel Lumina and the final have both been postponed to a later date.

The ruling hands Aurora Gaming an unexpected second chance. Aurora had won its first three matches 2-0, against Kryo Esports, Tantra Blitz and Enisorail, before losing to BONK in the round of 32 on 6 November. Project 100K had also swept its way through the early rounds, while YCATBLE beat Ninjas with Attitude and Royal Legion before running into BONK. All three now have to win again on Sunday evening to stay in contention.

title: Trial by Livestream: Why Indian Esports Settles Its Fights on YouTube
content:
On the evening of 7 November, GodLike Esports co-owner Chetan “Kronten” Chandgude went live on YouTube under a “Let’s Talk” banner and spoke for 101 minutes. He described a long-planned exit from his organisation, a close friend he said had worked “as a spy” since 2024, a one-third stake he tied to that exit, a recorded call with former GodLike figure Hades, and a police complaint.

He never said Jonathan’s name. The bench at BGIS 2026 and the timing of the exit he described match Jonathan Amaral’s departure, and viewers in the live chat discussed it on that basis. Within hours, clips with red arrows and “EXPOSED” thumbnails were on every BGMI channel, and the comment sections had reached their verdicts.

Nobody delivering those verdicts had seen a contract, the FIR, or the recording.

This editorial takes no side on what happened inside GodLike. We do not know, and neither does anyone whose only evidence is the stream. We do know how the dispute reached the public, because Indian esports has handled its fights this way for years. A grievance builds in private, then breaks open on a stream, then gets argued by fans, clip channels and anonymous X accounts until the next one replaces it. Nothing is resolved, and almost everyone involved comes out worse.

The GodLike case is the clearest example yet of a scene with no referee. It should also be the last one handled like this.

Start with what the stream put on the table, and what it showed. We set out the full account in our breakdown of Kronten’s full stream , so this is the short version.

title: Crazy Raccoon Set to Sign Japanese VALORANT Talent Aace for Its VCT Pacific Return
content:
Japanese initiator Souta “Aace” Ito is set to join Crazy Raccoon for the 2027 VCT Pacific season, according to a report by Sheep Esports on 8 November. The 20-year-old is a free agent after FENNEL confirmed on 4 November that he would leave the team when his contract expired. If the move goes through, it would make Aace the latest piece of a Crazy Raccoon roster being built around former DetonatioN FocusMe players. Crazy Raccoon has not announced the signing, and the player has not commented on the report.

The signing would be Aace’s first step into the top tier of VALORANT after three seasons in Challengers Japan. According to the report, he will reunite with Yu “akame” Gwang-hui and Ibuki “Meiy” Seki, two former DetonatioN FocusMe players. Kakeru “Vorz” Ikarashi, who also coached DFM, is expected to lead the team, and Sheep Esports had already reported that all three were set to join the club. Aace, Meiy and Vorz have also worked together recently in Japan’s national team.

Crazy Raccoon’s return to VALORANT is one of the bigger stories of the new partnership cycle. The Japanese organisation announced its comeback on 20 October, three years after missing out on a partnership for the 2023 to 2026 cycle. A day later, it was confirmed as a VCT Partner Team for the Pacific league on a two-year deal. According to Sheep Esports, Crazy Raccoon effectively takes the Japanese partner slot that DetonatioN FocusMe held. Our full list of the 32 VCT partner teams for 2027 and 2028 has every club in the new cycle.

Partnership no longer guarantees a full season under the new system, however. Crazy Raccoon will receive a direct invitation to the VCT Pacific Kickoff, which runs from 11 to 31 January. After that, the club is expected to go through the open qualifiers like every other team to earn a place in the Cups, as we explained in our breakdown of the VCT Pacific 2027 format . Japan has three qualifier slots for the Cups, the same number as Korea.

Aace first made his name with RIDDLE, which he joined in December 2023 after a year with ZETA DIVISION’s academy team. In 2024, he helped RIDDLE win Challengers Japan Split 2, beating FENNEL 3-2 in the final to qualify for Ascension Pacific. RIDDLE finished fourth there after a 2-0 defeat to BOOM Esports, who went on to earn a guest slot in VCT Pacific. He joined FENNEL at the end of October 2024.

His two seasons at FENNEL brought plenty of deep runs but no ticket to Ascension. FENNEL won the Split 3 main stage in 2025, but lost the Season Finals grand final 3-1 to his former team, RIDDLE. The team did win Japan’s qualifier for Red Bull Home Ground, where it beat Team RA’AD before going out in the group stage after a defeat to Cloud9. In 2026, FENNEL lost the Split 1 final 3-1 to Crest Gaming, finished fourth in Split 2 and went out to QT DIG in the Season Finals semi-finals.

title: Someone Made a Script That Emails Sam Altman Every Day About the RAM You’re Not Using
content:
A developer has turned Sam Altman’s complaint about idle PC memory into a daily joke at his expense. Ram-Altman is an open-source Bash script, published on GitHub by a developer using the handle IainKay. It checks how much memory is sitting unused on a Linux PC, and emails the OpenAI chief once a day if more than 10% of it is free. The project spread quickly on 8 November, when a post on X describing it passed 400,000 views within a few hours. It builds on Altman’s own description of RAM in personal computers as a waste, and on the “Ram Altman” name he briefly took on X last week.

The script runs quietly in the background through cron, sampling memory every five minutes. It reads the total and available memory figures that Linux reports in /proc/meminfo , and it counts reclaimable cache as available, so an idle desktop is likely to clear the threshold with ease. When it does, the script sends no more than one email a day, and each one uses a different message. A sample opens with “Please don’t be alarmed, but there is 8.6 GiB of RAM on my desk that isn’t in a data centre,” and signs off “Hoarding responsibly” from “A concerned RAM owner”.

The author has also built in a few guardrails against turning the joke into spam. The repository does not include any email address, and its README asks users not to add one, to send only from a real address of their own and to stop if the recipient asks. It warns that many copies sending at once would amount to a denial-of-service attack, and recommends a dry-run mode that prints the email instead of sending it. The script only works on Linux, and it is released under the Unlicense, which the README describes as “Free as in unallocated”.

The joke goes back to an interview Altman gave on Cheeky Pint, the podcast hosted by Stripe president John Collison, which went out on 29 October. Discussing the shortage of memory for AI data centres, Altman said it was “quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world’s limited supply of DRAM”. In his view, that memory sits in personal devices that use it about “5% of the time”. He added that “you want maximum utilization in the cloud” when supply is this tight. The clip spread fast, at a time when PC builders were already paying more for memory as AI servers absorb a growing share of DRAM production.

The reaction online was quick and mostly unkind. Elon Musk replied on 2 November that “The people deserve to have their RAM too!” , in a post viewed almost five million times. Two days later, Altman tried to reset the story, telling one critic on X that he wanted people “to have so much ram” and that the world should “build more”.

title: GodLike Owner Kronten’s Full Stream Explained: An FIR, Hades’s ‘Proof’ and a ‘Spy’ Inside the Team
content:
GodLike Esports co-owner Kronten says he has filed an FIR after uncovering what he called a long-planned exit from the organisation, and that former GodLike figure Hades handed him the first evidence of it. Kronten, whose real name is Chetan Chandgude, made the claims during a 101-minute live stream on his Kronten Gaming YouTube channel on 7 November, which had passed 455,000 views by Sunday. He also accused an unnamed GodLike manager of passing information to the other side for months while posing as his close friend. Kronten said he had shared only “10 to 15 percent” of what he knows, and that legal reasons stopped him from showing any proof on stream.

Kronten never said Jonathan’s name in the entire broadcast. The bench at BGIS 2026 and the timing of the exit he described match Jonathan’s departure, however, and viewers in the live chat discussed it on that basis. Our first report on the stream was based on clips shared while it was still live. This breakdown is based on TalkEsport’s translation of the full Hindi broadcast, with timestamps from the YouTube recording.

Kronten opened with the claim that has dominated the reaction since. “The bench story was completely false,” he said about six minutes in, adding that the organisation “did not bench anyone” and that the episode was “part of a plan”. Later, he swore on the Hindu deity Mahakal that management had “no role” in the decision. He claimed the player had a shoot booked on the day he sat out, and that the idea was for Godz to play in his place.

Kronten said his first hint that something was wrong came from Hades, who had left India to work and repay money he owed. According to Kronten, Hades reached co-owner Amar while the bench rumours were spreading, and Amar then pulled Kronten into the call. Hades allegedly sent screenshots, call logs and details of conference calls, and said a plan to leave GodLike had been made during a trip to Goa. Kronten said Hades had been due to join that trip but skipped it. He added that Hades asked him to record their conversation, which Kronten says he did.

The relationship between the two goes back further than that call. Kronten said he had given Hades around ₹10 to 15 lakh when he was in financial trouble, and that he does not want the money back. He claimed an unnamed GodLike manager had urged him not to help Hades, and wanted the pair kept apart so that information would not reach him. Kronten also disputed one of the main complaints against Hades, saying Hades had shown him an agreement in which money was given as an investment with a promised return, rather than as help.

According to Kronten, Hades was ready to return to India and back his account in public. Instead, Hades blocked him before coming back, and told him on a call about a month ago that he had found a job. Kronten did not say where, telling viewers that they were “smart” enough to work it out. Hades said on 5 November that he had worked on projects with Team Apex Gaming. Near the end of the stream, Kronten asked fans not to send Hades any hate and said his door remained open.

title: VCT Americas : Sentinels au complet avec keiko
content:
Le mercato continue de s’agiter sur la scène nord-américaine de VALORANT. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Georgio « keiko » Sanassy devrait rejoindre Sentinels pour la saison 2027 du VCT Americas. Le joueur britannique, qui évoluait chez NRG cette année, serait la dernière pièce du puzzle d’une formation largement reconstruite. Malgré de solides performances individuelles, keiko n’aura pas réussi à remporter de titre avec NRG en 2026, l’équipe échouant notamment à conserver sa couronne mondiale acquise lors des Champions 2025.

Révélé au plus haut niveau avec Team Liquid en 2025, keiko s’est rapidement imposé parmi les joueurs les plus talentueux de la scène internationale. Reconnu pour sa précision et sa régularité, le Britannique possède également un profil particulièrement polyvalent. Capable de briller sur des contrôleurs comme Omen et Brimstone, il peut aussi évoluer sur des agents plus offensifs, à l’image de Jett, Raze ou Chamber. Une flexibilité qui devrait lui permettre de s’intégrer facilement dans le nouveau projet de Sentinels, où il serait principalement chargé du rôle de contrôleur.

Après une année 2026 catastrophique, marquée par des résultats ne dépassant pas la 9-10e place, Sentinels semble déterminé à retrouver les premiers rôles. Reconduite parmi les équipes partenaires du VCT Americas pour le cycle 2027-2028, l’organisation américaine a multiplié les mouvements ambitieux sur le marché des transferts. L’arrivée attendue de keiko viendrait ainsi compléter un cinq particulièrement séduisant, composé de johnqt, brawk, OXY et du jeune espoir canezerra. Le Britannique retrouverait notamment son ancien coéquipier de NRG, brawk, tandis que johnqt conserverait un rôle central dans l’équipe.

Mais c’est surtout le duo de duelistes OXY-canezerra qui attire l’attention. Entre l’expérience du premier et le potentiel du second, Sentinels pourrait disposer de l’une des associations les plus explosives de la région. Sur le papier, cette nouvelle formation semble capable de rivaliser avec les meilleures équipes du championnat, notamment G2 Esports et Leviatán, qui préparent également des effectifs redoutables pour 2027. Après une saison à oublier, les supporters de Sentinels peuvent désormais espérer un retour au premier plan, aussi bien en VCT Americas que sur la scène internationale.

title: MOUZ Defeats MongolZ to Win IEM Beijing 2026
content:
MOUZ is the champion of the Intel Extreme Masters Beijing 2026 , beating MongolZ with a 3-0 scoreline to win their first IEM title in CS:GO or CS2. Dominant across the three maps, the Europeans made quick work of the Asian powerhouse to secure a confidence-boosting trophy ahead of the Singapore Major .

MOUZ did not drop a map from the upper-bracket final onwards. They beat PARIVISION 2-0 in that match to go straight to the semi-finals, swept BETBOOM 13-7 and 13-8 on Saturday, and then took Mirage, Dust2 and Inferno on Sunday. The MongolZ , on the other hand, had taken the longer road, reverse-sweeping FURIA in the group stage and then beating NAVI 2-0, a day after NAVI had come back from a map down against PARIVISION in the quarter-finals.

Opening the Grand Finals on MOUZ’s pick, MongolZ’s pistol-round win gave them some footing. As MOUZ managed to get going on the offence, the Asian side struggled heavily, allowing MOUZ to close the first half with an 8-4 lead. MOUZ extended the lead further with a 5-0 start on their defence as MongolZ managed a single round before closing the map with a 13-5 scoreline.

A dominant clean 3-0 sweep from @mousesports results in becoming the CHAMPIONS of #IEM Beijing 2026 – their first ever IEM title in CS:GO/CS2! Mirage 13-5 Dust 2 13-6 Inferno 13-4 pic.twitter.com/ABDllzcjnR

With the opening map going their way, MOUZ kicked off MongolZ’s pick with a 4-0 start. As MongolZ played chase, they put together five rounds to level the scoreline, making the map competitive. With MOUZ struggling poorly on their defence, their A-game started unfolding once they moved to T side. Winning 7 rounds in a row, MOUZ dismantled the MongolZ defence piece by piece to close the map without dropping a single round. With a 7-0 streak to close the map, MOUZ reached series point with a 13-6 win.

The final map of the series saw both teams trade rounds until MOUZ managed to secure consecutive rounds to go on a streak of 8 rounds before MongolZ narrowly managed the final two to swap sides with a 9-3 lead. Covering the pistol enabled MongolZ to hit the board, as the opening of the second half saw both teams cover their respective force buy. MOUZ found their footing quickly and pulled in 3 rounds in a row to close the map effortlessly with a 13-4 scoreline.

title: How xertioN took MOUZ from 11th to the top of the VRS
content:
Seven months after Brollan handed him the calls, the Israeli has MOUZ winning more maps, fragging harder himself and arriving in Singapore as the team to beat.

MOUZ beat The MongolZ 3-0 in the IEM Beijing grand final on Sunday, 13-5 on Mirage, 13-6 on Dust2 and 13-4 on Inferno, and xertioN was named MVP of the event. It is their second title since he took over the calls, and one more sign of how far the team has come in seven months.

When MOUZ benched Ludvig “Brollan” Brolin and Jimi “Jimpphat” Salo on 18 April, the bigger change was the one nobody could see on the roster sheet. Dorian “ xertioN ” Berman, until then an entry fragger, took over as in-game leader.

The first Valve Regional Standings after the switch, on 4 May, had MOUZ 11th, their lowest place of 2026. The latest, from 2 November, has them first with 1,960 points, 38 ahead of Vitality.

MOUZ had not won a title in 2026 before the change. Their best results under Brollan were third at PGL Cluj-Napoca and fourth at IEM Kraków, and the last event before the reset, IEM Rio, ended in fifth to sixth place after a 0-2 loss to Spirit.

The rebuild did not click overnight. xertioN called the IEM Cologne Major with Brollan back in the lineup, because Valve’s rules only allowed one change, and MOUZ went out with a 1-3 record. Afterwards coach Dennis “sycrone” Nielsen told HLTV that whatever happened with the rest of the roster, the captain was staying:

title: MOUZ beat MongolZ 3-0 to win IEM Beijing without losing a map
content:
xertioN was named MVP as MOUZ conceded only 15 rounds in the grand final and lifted their first IEM trophy of the CS:GO and CS2 era.

MOUZ are the IEM Beijing 2026 champions after a 3-0 win over The MongolZ in Sunday’s grand final, 13-5 on Mirage, 13-6 on Dust2 and 13-4 on Inferno. They finish the event 11-0 in maps. The title is worth $360,000, and The MongolZ take $210,000 for second place.

MOUZ had come close at IEM level for years without ever finishing the job, and their in-game leader Dorian “xertioN” Berman had lost all five IEM finals he had played before Sunday. In Beijing the wait ended in under three hours. MOUZ posted the result with a line that summed up the week: no map dropped all tournament.

WE ARE YOUR #IEM BEIJING CHAMPIONS! This is our first IEM trophy after not dropping a single map in this tournament. xertioN 🏆 Spinx 🏆 torzsi 🏆 xelex 🏆 PR 🏆 sycrone 🏆 xyp9x 🏆 Sabrina 🏆 Thank you, Beijing, China 🇨🇳 #VAMOUZ pic.twitter.com/3jysDYgcO7

On stage after the final, ESL’s host told the players that no team had won an IEM event of 16 or more teams without dropping a single map before. MOUZ went through TYLOO, BetBoom twice, PARIVISION and The MongolZ, five series and 11 maps, and the final was the most one-sided of them all.

The MongolZ had the better start. They won the opening pistol round on MOUZ’s own Mirage pick and made it awkward early, enough for coach sycrone to call a timeout with his players looking far from comfortable. It turned the map. MOUZ shut down the middle on the CT side, with xertioN, Lotan “Spinx” Giladi and xelex fighting for it together, and led 8-4 at the break. The second half lasted six rounds.

title: How to Share PS5 Games and PS Plus With Family for Free
content:
You can share your PS5 games and much of your PlayStation Plus subscription with family members for free, using a built-in feature called Console Sharing and Offline Play. Turn it on for a second PS5, download your games there, and anyone else who signs in to that console can play them, even when you are not around.

It is one of the most useful PS5 settings that many players never touch. Here is how it works, what you can share, and the limits Sony puts on it.

The setting is switched on automatically for the first PS5 you sign in to with your PlayStation Network account. To share with someone on another PS5, you need to turn it on there yourself.

Once the setting is on, stay signed in to your account on that PS5 and download the games and compatible DLC you want to share. Then sign in with your family member’s account on the same console. They can now play everything you downloaded, and you do not need to stay signed in for it to work.

The feature also covers offline play, so other users on that PS5 can play your digital games without an internet connection. That makes it handy for a child’s console or a second PS5 in the house.

Your PlayStation Plus subscription carries over too, but only partly. The account holder needs an active subscription for any of this to work, according to PlayStation’s support page on sharing PS Plus .

title: « Je ferai tout pour gagner ce foutu trophée » : la promesse de Caliste après les Worlds
content:
Le rêve de la Karmine Corp s’est brutalement arrêté face au triple champion du monde en titre. Malgré une belle réaction dans la troisième manche et une quatrième partie longtemps disputée, les Français n’ont pas réussi à renverser T1. Un scénario particulièrement frustrant pour Caliste, convaincu que son équipe avait les moyens de réaliser l’exploit. « Je suis très déçu. Nos deux premières games ont été ce qu’on ne voulait pas qu’elles soient. C’était la pire manière de rentrer dans le BO » , a confié le jeune ADC dans une interview accordée à L’Équipe . Entre une draft compliquée lors de la première manche et un important problème de communication dans la deuxième, la KC s’est rapidement retrouvée menée 2-0. « Rentrer dans le match comme ça, en ayant l’impression d’avoir jeté les deux premières manches, en étant déjà dos au mur, ça fait mal. »

Pourtant, les joueurs français n’ont jamais cessé d’y croire. Interrogé également par Ethan Cohen, Caliste a raconté l’état d’esprit du groupe après ce début de rencontre catastrophique. « On s’est clairement dit : on y va ensemble, soit on gagne ensemble, soit on meurt ensemble. » Une mentalité qui a permis à la Karmine Corp de sauver une première balle de match avant de finalement céder face à un Peyz exceptionnel. Le Français n’a d’ailleurs pas manqué de saluer son adversaire direct, qu’il considère comme l’une des grandes forces de T1. Mais malgré cette élimination, Caliste estime avoir prouvé qu’il pouvait rivaliser avec les meilleurs joueurs du monde.

Au-delà de la déception, ces premiers Worlds auront permis à la Karmine Corp de franchir un cap. Partie du Play-In, la structure française a atteint les quarts de finale dès sa première participation, accumulant une expérience précieuse face aux meilleures équipes de la planète. Un parcours qui donne surtout envie à Caliste de poursuivre l’aventure avec ses coéquipiers actuels : « Pour moi, les voyants sont au vert. On verra avec le mercato, ce n’est pas moi qui décide, mais on a montré de bonnes choses et le groupe marche vraiment bien. » , a-t-il expliqué. Le jeune joueur estime notamment qu’une deuxième année ensemble pourrait permettre à cette équipe d’atteindre un niveau encore supérieur.

Mais surtout, Caliste ne compte pas s’arrêter à ce premier quart de finale mondial. À peine éliminé, l’ADC français pense déjà à son retour sur la plus grande scène internationale. « Là, je n’ai qu’une envie, c’est rejouer le BO. Mais c’est comme ça, il va falloir rentrer, prendre l’avion » , a-t-il regretté, avant de lancer une promesse forte : « Je ferai tout pour revenir et gagner ce foutu trophée. » Une ambition qui résume parfaitement l’état d’esprit du joueur, bien décidé à transformer cette déception en motivation. Et même si la saison s’achève avec un goût d’inachevé, Caliste retient aussi les progrès accomplis : « On a gagné énormément de choses durant ces Mondiaux : de la confiance, du respect… » Pour lui comme pour la Karmine Corp, l’histoire ne fait peut-être que commencer.

title: GTA 6 Gets Japan’s Adults-Only CERO Z Rating, but Fans Fear Cuts
content:
GTA 6 has been rated CERO Z in Japan, the country’s highest age rating, meaning it is for players aged 18 and over only. The rating has appeared on the game’s Japanese PlayStation Store and Xbox Store listings, along with content warnings for crime and violence.

That clears the way for GTA 6 to launch in Japan, but it has not settled the question many Japanese players are asking. A CERO Z rating does not guarantee the uncut game, and Rockstar Games has not said whether the Japanese version will be changed.

CERO, the Computer Entertainment Rating Organization, gives games one of five ratings, from A for all ages up to Z for adults. Here is how the top end of the scale works.

In practice, Z goes further than a label on the box. Some Japanese retailers choose not to stock Z-rated games at all, and official websites and streams for them often sit behind age checks. For a game as big as GTA 6, that is unlikely to hurt sales much, but it shows how seriously Japan treats the top rating.

This is the part that worries fans. CERO has a list of banned depictions, including extreme gore, dismemberment and some depictions of corpses. A game that includes them cannot be rated at all, which blocks an official release. So even a Z-rated game sometimes has to be edited before it can launch.

There is plenty of recent precedent. Ubisoft toned down the gore in Assassin’s Creed Shadows for its Japanese release, and The Callisto Protocol was cancelled in Japan entirely after its developer chose not to make the cuts CERO asked for. Capcom’s own Resident Evil games, made in Japan, have shipped with milder violence there than overseas.

title: Call of Duty: Warzone Is Now Free on Nintendo Switch 2
content:
Call of Duty: Warzone is now on Nintendo Switch 2, and it costs nothing to play. The free-to-play battle royale is available in the Nintendo eShop, and you do not need to buy Modern Warfare 4 to jump in. If you already play Warzone elsewhere, signing in with the same Activision account brings your progress with you.

It is a big moment for Nintendo players. Before this year, the last Call of Duty on a Nintendo console was Call of Duty: Ghosts on Wii U, back in 2013.

Warzone arrived on Switch 2 alongside Season 1, which ties the battle royale into Modern Warfare 4. According to Activision’s Season 1 overview , the Switch 2 version gets the same features and seasonal content as other platforms, so there is no cut-down “Nintendo edition” to worry about.

Season 1 brings two new maps. Hajin is a full-size Battle Royale map set in South Korea, the first time Warzone has gone there, and it links to the Modern Warfare 4 campaign. Zodiac is a compact Resurgence map built around a drone factory.

At launch, playlists include Battle Royale, Resurgence and their Casual versions, plus Massive Resurgence and Loaded Resurgence. Extreme Resurgence and Rockets and Snipers are due mid-season.

The new season also reshuffled the weapon balance. Most guns got stronger rather than weaker, and if you want to know which loadouts to try first, our breakdown of every Season 1 weapon buff and nerf covers the full list.

title: Worlds 2026 : encore un 3-0, Gen.G s’offre enfin sa première finale !
content:
La première demi-finale des Worlds 2026 opposait ce samedi, à Allen au Texas, deux géants de la scène asiatique. D’un côté, Gen.G, champion en titre de la LCK et grand favori de la compétition. De l’autre, Invictus Gaming, emmené par les vétérans TheShy et Rookie, déjà sacrés champions du monde en 2018. Mais les espoirs chinois ont rapidement été refroidis. Dès la première manche, les Coréens ont imposé leur rythme, dominant leurs adversaires aussi bien mécaniquement que dans la gestion de la carte. Impérial sur Qiyana (7/1/12), Canyon a multiplié les initiatives décisives, tandis que Ruler a terminé le travail sur Jhin (9/2/11). Résultat : une première victoire expéditive en moins de 30 minutes.

GenG est dans la zone c'est terminé pic.twitter.com/w8DzfZeer9

La deuxième manche n’a fait que confirmer cette démonstration de force. Malgré les tentatives d’Invictus Gaming pour reprendre le contrôle de la série, Gen.G a une nouvelle fois dicté sa loi dans les combats collectifs. Le duo Ashe-Séraphine a particulièrement brillé, parfaitement accompagné par un Canyon intouchable sur Lee Sin (5/0/15). Toujours aussi précis dans ses déplacements et ses prises de décision, le jungler coréen a largement contribué à creuser l’écart. En quelques dizaines de minutes, Gen.G s’est ainsi retrouvé à une seule victoire de sa première finale mondiale.

Dos au mur, Invictus Gaming a finalement montré un tout autre visage dans la troisième manche. Avec une composition beaucoup plus agressive et un Rookie déchaîné sur Locke (11/1/5), les Chinois ont longtemps semblé capables de relancer la série. Mais Gen.G a une nouvelle fois démontré toute sa résilience. Un vol de dragon décisif, suivi d’un triplé de Ruler en milieu de partie, a complètement renversé la dynamique de la rencontre. Les champions de Corée ont progressivement effacé leur retard avant de reprendre le contrôle des objectifs.

Canyon mérite tellement sa finale des Worlds pic.twitter.com/zFbHK7VFjD

Tout s’est finalement joué lors d’un ultime teamfight explosif sur la midlane. Après avoir éliminé JiaQi en quelques instants, Gen.G a remporté le combat décisif et détruit le Nexus adverse au terme de 40 minutes particulièrement intenses. Une victoire 3-0 sans appel, même si Invictus Gaming aura offert une belle résistance dans cette dernière manche. Pour TheShy et Rookie, le rêve d’un deuxième sacre mondial s’arrête donc aux portes de la finale.

title: NAVI avenge Bucharest loss to take third in Beijing
content:
b1t and w0nderful ran the middle of BetBoom’s own Mirage pick as NAVI won 2-0 to finish on the IEM Beijing podium.

NAVI finished third at IEM Beijing 2026 after a 2-0 win over BetBoom Team on Sunday morning, 13-6 on Mirage and 13-9 on Ancient. It was their first meeting since BetBoom beat them 2-0 at PGL Masters Bucharest two weeks ago. Third place is worth $160,000; BetBoom take $120,000 for fourth.

NAVI made no secret of what the match meant to them. Before the first map the team wrote on X that there was “a chance to settle the score for Bucharest”, where BetBoom had beaten them 13-9 on Nuke and 13-10 on Dust2 on 26 October.

More prize money on the line and a chance to settle the score for Bucharest. Our journey at #IEM Beijing 2026 concludes with a battle for 3rd place. Tune in! #navination pic.twitter.com/uUZBPdJanZ

BetBoom’s own pick gave them the first chance. Mirage had been NAVI’s weakest map over the past three months, won in only four of their 12 attempts, and they lost it 14-16 in overtime to PARIVISION in Friday’s quarter-final. For BetBoom it was the opposite: their most played map and their best, 59% over 17 maps.

On Sunday that counted for nothing. BetBoom’s T side kept trying to take the middle of the map, and Valeriy “b1t” Vakhovskiy , iM and makazze kept pushing through connector to meet them first. NAVI led 9-3 at the half, won the second pistol for 10-3, and BetBoom coach Fierce called a timeout straight after the break. BetBoom found three rounds in a row after that, but NAVI went back to their A attacks and closed the map 13-6.

title: Fortnite Pirate Token odds confirmed: Here are the chances you will find it
content:
Epic Games has finally confirmed the odds of a player finding the coveted Pirate Shop Access, which grants you every item in the Item Shop for 14 consecutive days. After much discussion, you have a 1-in-137,500 chance of finding it in a Chest.

That merely scratches the surface of what Epic Games revealed after over 8 million players queued into Fortnite during today’s Treasure Hour. Here’s everything you should know moving forward!

You asked for info on drop rates, so here’s how it works: The new treasure this season is found in chests just like other items. Treasure drop rates from chests are constant since season launch and don’t vary throughout the day, except during Treasure Hours. Other than Gizmos,…

Epic Games confirmed you have a 1-in-137,500 chance to loot the Pirate Shop Token from a normal Chest. While the odds sound scary, thousands of players have found it since the Treasure Hunters season launched a few days ago.

The Pirate Shop Token isn’t even the rarest treasure currently available in the game. The Weekly Gold Outfit holds that honor. However, as it stands, the Token is incredibly rare, and your chances increase greatly during the Power/Treasure Hours .

Fortnite’s Senior Director, Chris Yu , has said the odds are similar to finding the Zero Point Sprite from Chapter 7 Season 3.

title: Major champion chopper retires from professional play
content:
A day after Spirit let him go, the captain who won the Shanghai Major has confirmed he will not play again.

Leonid “chopper” Vishnyakov has retired as a professional player. The 29-year-old confirmed the decision to HLTV on Saturday evening, one day after Team Spirit parted ways with him and more than ten years after his career began.

In his statement, chopper thanked the two organisations he spent most of his career with, Vega Squadron and Spirit, and singled out Spirit as the place where he grew up as a player:

In Team Spirit, I established myself as a player, evolved professionally and improved my media skills. Besides, here I achieved the major milestones of my career.

He also thanked Nikolay “Certus”, who gave him the IGL role, and coach Sergey “hally”, with whom he “learned to win”. He signed off to the fans with a hint at what he does now: “Thank you for being there for us, and see you on the streams!”

The statement settles a question that had hung over chopper since Spirit benched him on 18 December 2025. He has streamed and worked as a community caster since then, and in October he wrote on Telegram that he was finished, Hawk Live reported :

title: LEC : Wunder ne sera pas le toplaner de SK Gaming en 2027
content:
C’est une nouvelle page qui se tourne pour Martin « Wunder » Hansen. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , SK Gaming aurait pris la décision de ne pas renouveler le contrat de son toplaner pour la saison 2027 du LEC. Arrivé en début d’année dans un projet ambitieux construit autour de Mikyx, le Danois de 27 ans n’aura finalement passé qu’une saison sous les couleurs de la structure allemande. Son départ attendu marque la fin d’un effectif qui devait permettre à SK de retrouver les sommets européens, mais qui n’a jamais réussi à répondre aux attentes.

Sur le papier, l’équipe avait pourtant de quoi séduire. Avec Wunder, Skeanz, LIDER, Jopa et Mikyx, SK Gaming avait misé sur un mélange d’expérience et de talent pour jouer les premiers rôles. Mais les résultats ont rapidement tourné au fiasco. Onzième du LEC Versus avec seulement trois victoires en onze rencontres, la formation allemande a ensuite terminé huitième du Spring Split. Même l’arrivée de SlowQ à la place de LIDER n’a pas permis d’inverser la tendance durant l’été. Résultat : aucune qualification en playoffs sur l’ensemble de la saison 2026, un bilan particulièrement décevant pour une équipe qui nourrissait de grandes ambitions.

Pour Wunder, ce nouvel échec soulève forcément des interrogations. Ancien pilier du G2 Esports qui avait dominé l’Europe et atteint la finale des Worlds 2019, le Danois peine à retrouver son meilleur niveau depuis plusieurs saisons. Son passage chez Heretics en 2024 s’était déjà soldé par une déception, avant une année loin de la compétition faute de projet suffisamment intéressant. Son retour chez SK devait lui permettre de relancer sa carrière, mais l’expérience n’aura pas porté ses fruits. Reste désormais à savoir si le vétéran tentera de rebondir dans une autre équipe ou s’il choisira de prendre à nouveau du recul.

De son côté, SK Gaming prépare un changement radical de philosophie pour 2027. Exit le projet construit autour de joueurs expérimentés, place à une nouvelle génération issue notamment des ligues régionales européennes. Le jungler français Zicssi, champion de LFL et des EMEA Masters avec Solary, aurait trouvé un accord verbal avec l’organisation. Il devrait être accompagné de son compatriote 3XA sur la botlane et du support coréen Lospa, tandis que SlowQ conserverait son poste sur la midlane. Seule la toplane reste donc à pourvoir, les dirigeants ayant déjà entamé des discussions avec plusieurs candidats. Une reconstruction presque totale qui pourrait permettre à SK de repartir sur de nouvelles bases après une année à oublier.
