title: VCT 2027 Open Qualifiers Add Ascendant Requirement and Stricter Anti-Cheat Checks
content:
Riot Games is tightening competitive integrity rules for the 2027 VALORANT Champions Tour as the circuit prepares to open its qualification system to more teams than ever before.

Players entering VCT 2027 Open Qualifiers will need to meet minimum rank requirements, pass Vanguard-related checks and compete with accounts in good standing. Teams that progress deeper into qualification will also face increasingly strict monitoring, including POV recordings, voice monitoring and cameras covering the match area.

The changes are designed to support Riot’s new open VCT model while limiting the risks created by a much larger pool of online competitors.

Riot has confirmed that every player entering an Open Qualifier must have reached at least Ascendant within the previous six months.

The requirement applies across the team rather than only to a captain or selected starters.

Riot’s VCT Compete hub also states that teams need five starting players and can generally field a maximum of two players from outside the region in which they are competing.

title: A College Team Just Won Vietnam’s Arena of Valor League at My Dinh, Beating BOOM Esports 4-2
content:
FPT Polytechnic have won Vietnam’s Arena of Glory for the first time, beating BOOM Esports 4-2 in the Winter 2026 Grand Final at My Dinh National Stadium in Hanoi on 7 November. The team is backed by a Vietnamese college and only entered Garena’s top Arena of Valor league, known locally as Đấu Trường Danh Vọng, in 2025. Captain Vịt was named Finals MVP, and his side became the first champions other than Team Flash or Saigon Phantom since Winter 2017, according to Liquipedia. The final opened Liên Quân 10Fest, Garena’s celebration of ten years of the game in Vietnam, where it is called Liên Quân Mobile.

BOOM Esports, the Indonesian organisation playing its debut season in the league, had the better start to the series. Tama was named MVP on Dolia as BOOM won the opening game, before FPT Polytechnic levelled through Sleepy on Liliana. BOOM went 2-1 up when their dragon lane carry ĐứcTiệp starred on Violet, but FPT Polytechnic then won three games in a row to take the title. Vịt, whose real name is Lê Văn Việt, plays in the Dark Slayer lane and receives 50 million dong as Finals MVP. More than 28,000 people were watching on Garena’s main YouTube stream alone during the closing games.

The venue was almost as big a story as the result. According to Znews, it was the first esports tournament ever held at My Dinh, the home of Vietnam’s national football team. Garena had expected around 40,000 people across the festival’s two days, but Znews put Saturday’s crowd at about 25,000 in a stadium that holds roughly 40,000. The mobile esports analyst hesketh2, who works on Liquipedia’s Asia-Pacific mobile coverage but posts in a personal capacity, called it the first attempt to stage a mobile game in an open stadium outside China. He added that the crowd had passed the halfway mark, although rows of empty seats were visible in the central stands.

This is first ever attempt for a Mobile Game to host in an Open Stadium area, that isn't from a country called China Unfortunately they were not able to fill the whole stadium (40,000~?) but does get past halfway pic.twitter.com/rqN0fL3DUp

Moving the final into a national stadium was a deliberate statement from Garena. My Dinh mainly hosts international football matches and major concerts, and the official 10Fest ticket page sold separate seats for each day through Cticket.vn. Liên Quân players with a level 15 account could buy tickets from 20 September, six days before sales opened to the public. Fans who checked in on both days could also claim a limited skin chest, which gave players a reason to attend the concert as well as the final.

The bracket did not help the attendance, however. Team Flash, one of the most popular teams in the country, had already been knocked out in October after losing 4-3 to BOX Gaming in the lower bracket. That left only three teams still alive on the final day. Saigon Phantom, often described as the most decorated team in the league’s history, then lost the lower bracket final 4-2 to BOOM in the afternoon. Several Vietnamese fans replying to hesketh2 said many Saigon Phantom supporters left after that defeat, before the evening grand final began.

title: Free Fire India’s Booyah Premier League Is Back, and the BPL 2027 Auction Is Set for 18 November
content:
Garena’s Free Fire India has confirmed that the Booyah Premier League is coming back, with the BPL 2027 player auction set for 18 November. The announcement came in an Instagram reel posted on 7 November, which asks fans “Kiski boli sabse zyada lagegi?”, or “whose bid will go the highest?”. The caption says the auction will be streamed live on the Free Fire India Official YouTube channel, and the reel ends on the words “BPL 2027 Auctions, 18 Nov”. Garena has not yet named the teams, owners, venue or prize pool for the new season.

The 20-second teaser borrows the language of a cricket auction, showing a bidder raising a paddle in a darkened room before the date appears. Instagram labels the reel as AI content, and its caption opens with “Abhi maza aayega na bhidu”, a line built to get fans guessing. The reel had passed 8,000 likes within an hour of going live. It follows a “BPL is back!” Short that Free Fire India posted on YouTube in late October, which showed the BPL logo over a floodlit stadium.

The first season gave the community a clear idea of what to expect. Garena announced the league in January as a cricket tournament for Free Fire MAX creators and esports players, built around six franchises named after the game’s maps. Bermuda Blasters, Peak Panthers, Alpine Aces, Kalahari Knights, Nexterra Nawabs and Solara Sultans were each owned by a pair of well-known creators. Peak Panthers, for example, belonged to Pahadi Gaming and S8UL’s Sid, while comedian Kullu and Assassins Army co-owned Bermuda Blasters. Nexterra Nawabs belonged to TSG Ritik and Sooneeta, Solara Sultans to Munnabhai Gaming and Nonstop Gaming, Alpine Aces to Badge 99 and PN Rose, and Kalahari Knights to Desi Gamers and Kaashvi.

Every franchise then built its squad through a player auction on 10 January, using a virtual budget of ₹5 crore. Each team also had one marquee player signed before bidding began, including Fozy Ajay, Delete, Vasiyo and Rocky RDX. As our live auction coverage tracked, RNT Black became the most expensive pick, joining Solara Sultans for a virtual ₹1.75 crore. Free Fire India’s Auction Day video has since passed 1.7 million views on YouTube.

The tournament itself was played on 31 January and 1 February at the EKA Arena in Ahmedabad, with a ₹10 lakh prize pool. The six teams were split into two groups of three before the knockout rounds, and every match was streamed on Free Fire India’s YouTube channel. Nexterra Nawabs, owned by TSG Ritik and Sooneeta, won the title by beating Bermuda Blasters in the final, according to Free Fire India’s final highlights . The full finals stream has drawn more than 1.5 million views.

The second season will be the league’s first under the new Free Fire India banner. Garena released the localised game on Android and iOS on 28 October, as we reported when the Free Fire India download went live . That launch came four years after the original Free Fire was banned in India, and the game is listed on the Google Play Store under a new India-specific package. A creator league with big auction numbers gives Garena an easy way to drive attention back to the new app.

title: GodLike vs Jonathan: What Really Happened? Kronten Says Management Never Benched Him
content:
GodLike Esports co-owner Kronten has reopened the story of Jonathan’s exit, telling viewers on a live stream on 7 November that the “benched” narrative around the split was never what it seemed. Kronten, whose real name is Chetan Chandgude, went live on his Kronten Gaming YouTube channel at 8:03 pm IST under the title “Truth can’t be hidden | hard, but its time to talk”.

According to clips from the stream shared widely on X, he said GodLike’s management never benched Jonathan and that Jonathan had planned his move away from the organisation well in advance. More than 20,000 people were watching the stream live by around 9:30 pm IST, and neither Jonathan nor Team Apex Gaming had responded publicly by then.

To understand why the stream has caused such a stir, it helps to go back to March, when Jonathan’s last weeks at GodLike began. What happened at BGIS 2026 has been told several different ways since then, by Jonathan, by GodLike’s co-owners and by their players. Most of those accounts are already on the record, and read together they explain where today’s dispute really lies.

Jonathan joined GodLike in August 2021 as part of the former TSM roster, and he spent more than four years as the face of the organisation. His first real break with that role came on 16 March 2026, when he sat out Day 1 of the BGIS 2026 Survival Stage in Hyderabad. GodLike fielded Manya, Admino, Spower and Godz instead, and the team topped the standings that day. Captain Manya said afterwards that the decision was purely strategic, and on 17 March Jonathan left the venue for a shoot in Mumbai .

GodLike’s co-owners spoke publicly within days of the benching. Co-owner Amar first called the rumours “baseless” and said the team still dreamed of an official trophy with Jonathan, as we reported at the time . A few days later, he described the episode as “the situation” of “Jonathan getting benched”, and said a poor final day of the semi-finals was not the fault of any single player. Jonathan, for his part, said on a stream with ZGod that he had made the benching decision himself, with the team’s best interest in mind.

Jonathan returned for the Grand Finals in Chennai from 27 to 29 March, where GodLike finished fifth. He then told fans on Instagram that “very new changes and crazy things” were coming, and he confirmed on a livestream in early April that he was leaving GodLike. On 7 April, Kronten said Jonathan had been making the decision “for the past three to four months”, and that Jonathan had shared his future plans with him during BGIS 2026.

content:

title: Thieves Rammed a Pickup Into a Tacoma Card Shop and Took $50,000 in Pokémon and Magic Cards
content:
A Tacoma card shop is hiring overnight security guards after thieves rammed a pickup truck through its back door and escaped with around $50,000 worth of Pokémon and Magic: The Gathering cards. The burglary hit Northwest Sportscards on 6th Avenue shortly after 5 a.m. on Monday, 2 November, KOMO News reported . Owner Don Knutsen, who has run the shop for nearly 40 years, said the burglars were “in and out in just a couple of minutes”. Tacoma police are investigating, and no arrests had been reported by Saturday.

It was not the first time the shop had been targeted this year, either. Knutsen and police believe the same people were behind an attempted break-in in July and a burglary in August, when a window was smashed and thousands of dollars in sports cards were taken. “Same truck, same method for ramming in the door,” Knutsen told MyNorthwest . He added that the thieves “had cased the place, no doubt about it”.

Security footage from the shop shows a black pickup driving into the warehouse entrance, before masked suspects load containers with hundreds of boxes of cards. According to MyNorthwest, the pair drove off and then returned about a minute later to take even more stock. Police said the suspects “used a pickup truck to ram through the business’s rear metal doors”. Knutsen said the thieves filled the bed of the truck with sealed product from the shelves and the storeroom.

Investigators have released a detailed description of the vehicle they want to find. It is a 2006 or 2007 Dodge Ram 2500 or 3500 with a Mega Cab or extended cab, a broken taillight on the driver’s side and damage to the rear bumper. The truck was carrying a Washington plate, C12766M, which had been reported stolen. Crime Stoppers of Tacoma-Pierce County is offering up to $1,000 for information that leads to an arrest and charges, while Knutsen has put up a separate $5,000 reward of his own.

The type of stock taken makes the case harder to solve. Knutsen said many of the stolen Pokémon and Magic: The Gathering products were sealed, with no serial numbers or other identifying marks. Graded sports cards are far easier to trace, because each slab carries its own certification number. He is now watching resale listings closely and contacting other dealers in case the stolen boxes are offered to them.

Demand for Pokémon products has rarely been higher, which also raises their value to thieves. The franchise is in its 30th anniversary year, and fans in France camped outside a Fnac store a day early this week for the 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection. The anniversary has also sparked a surge of interest in markets such as the Netherlands , built around the 30th Celebration set that launched worldwide on 16 September. At the very top of the market, Logan Paul’s Pikachu Illustrator card sold for a record $16.4 million in February. Knutsen himself said rising card prices had brought new security problems for his business.

title: GTA 6 Boxes Are Already Reaching Stores, and the PS5 Case Confirms No Disc, 230GB and Online Functions
content:
GTA 6 boxes appear to be reaching shops, 12 days before the game launches. A Reddit user who says they work in retail in Germany posted photos of a sealed PlayStation 5 copy of Grand Theft Auto VI on Saturday, 7 November, under the title “First ‘physical’ copy arrived”. The images show a German edition with a USK 18 rating, and the uploader added that there were “many more to come”. Rockstar Games has not commented on the photos, but the case matches what the publisher has already said about boxed copies of the game.

The photos were posted to the r/GTA6unmoderated subreddit by u/IseeIceTea, and they spread quickly after CharlieIntel shared them on X. The poster said they could not open the box because of their job, and that it made no sound when they shook it. Asked whether a paper map was inside, they replied “I don’t think so”, while admitting that they had no way of checking. TalkEsport has not been able to verify the photos independently, although the packaging follows Rockstar’s official cover art and Germany’s rating rules closely.

The front of the case uses the multi-panel cover art that Rockstar revealed earlier this year, with Jason, Lucia and several other characters arranged around the Grand Theft Auto logo. The most important detail sits in a small strip near the bottom, which reads “Spiel-Downloadcode. Keine Disc enthalten.” That translates as “game download code, no disc included”, and it confirms that the German box follows the same code-in-box plan as other regions. A smaller footnote under the strip is too blurred to read in full in the photos.

The back of the box is far more revealing. A row of feature icons lists one player, online functions, in-game purchases and support for the DualSense controller’s vibration and trigger effects. Another icon marks the game as optimised for the PlayStation 5 Pro, while a storage label states a minimum of 230 GB. The case also carries a German version of Rockstar’s story blurb under the heading “Jason und Lucia”, along with the line “Willkommen in Vice City” and three in-game screenshots.

The German rating label adds more detail than a standard age badge. Its descriptors list graphic violence, criminal role models and drugs, and a separate line states that the game contains in-game purchases. The small print says the download code can only be used once, and that some features may require an internet connection and a registered Rockstar Games account, with a minimum age that varies. The web address printed at the bottom of the case is rockstargames.com/VI.

The storage figure on the box is higher than any number Rockstar has given so far. In its Newswire post on 3 November , the studio confirmed that pre-loading begins on 10 November, and the download has been reported at up to 212 GB depending on the console. Installing a game usually needs extra free space on top of the download itself, which could explain the 230 GB minimum printed on the case. Our guide to freeing up PS5 storage without deleting your games is worth a look for anyone already close to the limit.

title: Former Rockstar Technical Director Says AI Rip-Offs Could Force GTA 6 Onto PC Sooner
content:
GTA 6 could reach PC sooner than Rockstar’s usual pattern suggests, because of the threat of unofficial ports built with AI, according to former Rockstar North technical director Obbe Vermeij. Speaking to Rock Paper Shotgun, Vermeij said that if he were still at the studio, he would be worried about “somebody” taking the PlayStation 5 version and getting AI to convert it. Rockstar has not announced a PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI, and its official site still lists the game only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game launches on 19 November, less than two weeks away.

Vermeij knows the series’ PC history better than most. He worked at DMA Design and Rockstar North on Grand Theft Auto III, Vice City, San Andreas and GTA IV, and left the company after GTA IV. Since then, he has become one of the most quoted former Rockstar developers online, regularly answering fan questions on his X account . In August, he described the flood of GTA 6 leaks as a “nothing burger” that would not affect sales.

This time, Vermeij sounded far more concerned about the effect on sales. He said an unofficial PC version made with AI “won’t be as good as their effort, but it could still also hurt their sales”. He also suggested that someone would almost certainly try, because “if it’s GTA”, people will take the shot. According to the interview, he estimated that converting a game of this size would take many hours of machine time and cost tens of thousands of dollars in AI tokens.

He was careful to say that he has no inside knowledge of Rockstar’s plans, however. Even so, he said he would not be surprised to see “an effort to get [the releases] a little bit closer together”. Vermeij also pointed out that Take-Two, Rockstar’s parent company, would have strong legal grounds to act against anyone who released an unofficial port. Take-Two has form here, having had the fan-made re3 and reVC reverse-engineering projects for GTA III and Vice City taken down in 2021 before suing their developers.

Since Grand Theft Auto III, every mainline GTA has reached PC some time after its console launch. GTA IV arrived on PS3 and Xbox 360 in April 2008, but did not reach PC until December 2008. GTA V took even longer, launching on consoles in September 2013 and on PC in April 2015, while Red Dead Redemption 2 followed in October 2018 with a PC release in November 2019. Vermeij has said before that PC was a much smaller priority in his era, writing that the PC market “was nowhere near as big as console at the time” in a post in September .

The wider worry about unofficial copies is already on Take-Two’s mind. This week, CEO Strauss Zelnick admitted that GTA 6 will be pirated , while arguing that the game’s size, modern console security and regular updates make it harder to copy. GTA VI’s PS5 download alone is around 210GB , and Rockstar confirmed in its Newswire post that pre-loading starts on 10 November. An AI port would have to work around all of that, which is why Vermeij expects any attempt to be both expensive and inferior.

title: Jonathan’s TAG Moves Into EA FC Mobile, Signing DeMYSTeRIO and HaloZeus
content:
Team Apex Gaming have moved into EA Sports FC Mobile, signing HaloZeus and DeMYSTeRIO as the organisation’s first players in the football game. TAG announced the pair on X at around 8:05 pm IST on 7 November, calling them “the dynamic duo for EA FC Mobile”. The announcement graphic shows both players in TAG’s Kick-branded shirts, under the FC Mobile logo. It is the latest expansion for the Indian organisation that Jonathan launched less than seven months ago.

THE DYNAMIC DUO FOR EA FC MOBILE IS HERE! Welcoming HaloZeus and DeMYSTeRIO to Team Apex Gaming. #TAGonTOP pic.twitter.com/pYKJj8rKqV

The signing also capped a busy day for the organisation. TAG posted its cryptic “national treasure” chess teaser that morning, and as we explored earlier , almost every clue points to Vidit Gujrathi. The FC Mobile announcement did not mention chess, however, and TAG had still not named its chess player by the time the duo were revealed. The two moves together show an organisation that is now spreading well beyond its BGMI roots.

DeMYSTeRIO is the bigger name of the two, and one of the best-known FC Mobile creators in India. His YouTube channel has around 335,000 subscribers, where he streams almost daily and posts tutorials, team reviews and formation guides. EA featured him in its Creator Spotlight series , describing him as one of the most popular FC Mobile content creators from India. In that profile, he said he started playing in 2019, when he got his first mobile phone. He also runs a Discord community where FC Mobile players share their squads and ask him for team reviews.

He has also built a competitive record alongside his content. In June 2025, he travelled to the FC Mobile Festival in Bangkok, which he described in a YouTube video as the first time an Indian had represented the country at an FC Mobile esports event. Last month, he posted another video titled “I Became the FC Mobile Champion at Gaming Con!” , days after GamingCon Bharat 2026 in Mumbai. The convention ran on 17 and 18 October, and Ampverse hosted an EA Sports FC Mobile 27 activation there.

HaloZeus has a lower public profile but makes strong claims about his own level. His X bio describes him as the number one Indian player of 2022/23 and a top 50 player globally. It also calls him a budding content creator, so he arrives at TAG with an audience-building plan of his own. TalkEsport has not been able to verify those rankings independently, and TAG did not add details about either player’s achievements in its announcement.

title: “Stop Manipulating Chinese Women”: Counter-Strike Star Jimpphat Hit With Allegations in Viral Douyin Post
content:
Aurora rifler Jimi “Jimpphat” Salo has been accused of mistreating a former partner, in a statement posted on the Chinese video platform Douyin by a woman who says she is his ex-girlfriend. The post, written in Chinese with an English version alongside it, began circulating on X on Saturday, 7 November, after Counter-Strike news and fan accounts shared and translated it. It accuses the 20-year-old Finn of love-bombing her around the Perfect World Shanghai Major in 2024, and of making derogatory comments about Chinese people and Asian men. TalkEsport has not verified the statement, the identity of its author or any of the claims in it.

Jimpphat has not responded publicly to the accusations. His most recent post on his X account came on 29 October, after Aurora were knocked out of PGL Masters Bucharest by his former team MOUZ. Aurora’s CS2 account has not addressed the statement either, and its last posts followed the team’s exit from IEM Beijing 2026 on 4 November. Neither the player nor the organisation had commented by Saturday evening.

The statement is addressed directly to Jimpphat, and its English version opens with the line “Please stop manipulating the feelings of Chinese women”. Its author claims that he love-bombed her during the 2024 Shanghai Major, pretending to want a relationship while publicly presenting himself as single. She says the couple broke up three times between May and July 2025. After each break-up, she alleges, he repeatedly suggested that they become friends with benefits, which she says she refused every time.

The most serious claims in the post concern race. According to the statement, Jimpphat once told her that his family disapproved of their relationship simply because she was Chinese. She also alleges that he repeatedly made derogatory comments about Asian men. The post then accuses him of holding a prejudice against Chinese people while using Chinese social media to win attention and engagement from Chinese fans.

The author also claims that he invited her to watch his matches at IEM Chengdu, an invitation she says she declined. She writes that she is not a streamer or an influencer, that she has started a new chapter in her life and that she hopes other women will not be deceived. TalkEsport is not naming the author or linking to her account, because she is a private individual.

The statement reached English-speaking fans through X rather than through any official channel. The CS2 news account LycheeCS shared a summary on Saturday afternoon, noting that the accusations were unverified and that Jimpphat had not responded. Fan accounts also posted machine translations of the Chinese text, with at least one asking Chinese speakers to correct the wording. No esports organisation, tournament organiser or Douyin itself has commented on the post.

title: LEC : Thayger quitte Galions et va faire son retour chez GIANTX
content:
Le mercato continue de s’agiter en Europe, et GIANTX tient visiblement son nouveau jungler. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Francisco « Thayger » Sánchez aurait trouvé un accord verbal avec l’organisation espagnole pour la saison 2027 du LEC. Âgé de 24 ans, le joueur devrait ainsi retrouver l’élite européenne après un premier passage compliqué chez Natus Vincere durant le Summer Split 2025. Cette fois, il arrive avec un tout autre statut, après une année particulièrement réussie sous les couleurs de Galions.

Le choix de Thayger n’était pourtant pas évident. Toujours selon la même source, le jungler aurait également discuté avec SK Gaming et Vitality, allant même jusqu’à participer à plusieurs journées de scrims avec les Abeilles. Mais alors que la structure française continuait d’évaluer d’autres candidats, GIANTX lui aurait transmis une offre concrète, assortie d’une date limite pour donner sa réponse. Plutôt que d’attendre une éventuelle proposition de Vitality, l’Espagnol aurait finalement choisi de s’engager avec son compatriote, séduit par le projet sportif.

Il faut dire que Thayger sort de la meilleure saison de sa carrière. Après avoir remporté la Superliga espagnole avec le Barça eSports en 2025, le jungler avait rejoint Galions pour tenter de se relancer en LFL. Un pari largement réussi : malgré une défaite face à Solary en finale du Spring Split, la formation française a pris sa revanche en remportant les EMEA Masters Spring sur un impressionnant 3-0, avec Thayger élu MVP de la finale. Galions a ensuite confirmé sa domination durant l’été, en décrochant le titre de champion de France face à TLN Pirates (3-1), mais surtout en remportant les EMEA Masters Summer. Un deuxième sacre européen consécutif qui a permis à la structure française de réaliser une saison mémorable.

Du côté de GIANTX, cette arrivée s’inscrit dans une profonde reconstruction de l’effectif. Après avoir tenté de recruter Lyncas, finalement attendu chez G2, puis Razork, qui aurait choisi Heretics, les dirigeants espagnols ont décidé de miser sur Thayger. Ce dernier devrait retrouver les Sud-Coréens Feisty et Piero, lui aussi passé par la LFL avec Solary. À l’inverse, Jackies et Jun devraient prendre la direction de Team Heretics. Avec trois recrues prometteuses et un jungler double champion des EMEA Masters en 2026, GIANTX espère désormais franchir un cap et s’installer durablement parmi les meilleures équipes du LEC.

[SOURCES] Jungler Thayger has reached a verbal agreement with GIANTX for the 2027 #LEC season The 24-year-old is back to the LEC after finishing WSCI in 3rd/4th place with Galions. Report by @LEC_Wooloo , @anonimotum & @i_Eros_ https://t.co/CpR5kOLP9s

title: VCT EMEA : FUT Esports reconstruit son équipe autour de Wo0t
content:
C’est l’un des mouvements marquants de cette intersaison sur VALORANT. Après plus de deux ans passés sous les couleurs de Team Heretics, Mert « Wo0t » Alkan a officiellement rejoint FUT Esports. Le joueur turc, considéré comme l’un des plus grands talents mécaniques de sa génération, retrouve ainsi une formation entièrement composée de compatriotes. Révélé au plus haut niveau en 2024, Wo0t avait notamment crevé l’écran lors des Masters Shanghai, où il avait temporairement remplacé MiniBoo au poste de duelliste. Avec des statistiques impressionnantes (247 ACS et 1.21 de K/D), il avait largement contribué au parcours de Team Heretics jusqu’en finale. Des performances qui l’avaient immédiatement propulsé parmi les joueurs les plus prometteurs de la scène internationale.

Mais depuis cette explosion, le joueur de 20 ans a connu une trajectoire plus irrégulière. Malgré quelques prestations remarquées, notamment lors des Champions 2025, Wo0t n’a jamais véritablement retrouvé son niveau exceptionnel de Shanghai. Ses nombreux changements de rôle au sein de Team Heretics n’ont pas facilité sa progression, et son départ en octobre dernier semblait ouvrir la porte à un nouveau défi. D’après les informations de Sheep Esports , Vitality et Sentinels auraient notamment envisagé son recrutement, mais le Turc aurait préféré patienter pour rejoindre FUT. Un choix qui pourrait lui permettre de retrouver de la stabilité et de relancer sa carrière dans un environnement familier.

Et Wo0t ne devrait pas être la seule nouveauté de l’effectif. Toujours selon Sheep Esports , FUT aurait également jeté son dévolu sur deux anciens joueurs de Fire Flux : Berkay « hezacoil » Doğar et Mehmet Batu « batujnax » Özaslan. Âgé de 19 ans, le premier s’est notamment illustré sur les rôles de contrôleur et de sentinelle, tandis que le second évolue principalement au poste d’initiateur. Les deux joueurs ont participé au remarquable parcours de Fire Flux lors du VCT EMEA Stage 2 en 2026, conclu à la quatrième place après des victoires face à Vitality, Heretics et BBL Esports.

Ces arrivées s’inscrivent dans une reconstruction importante pour FUT Esports, qui s’est déjà séparé de xeus, s0pp, sociablEE et de son entraîneur Vlad. Troisième des deux principaux splits européens en 2026, la structure turque reste à la recherche de son premier trophée en VCT, malgré sept participations à des compétitions internationales. Reconduite parmi les huit équipes partenaires du circuit EMEA pour 2027 et 2028, elle espère désormais franchir un cap avec ce nouvel effectif. Autour d’un Wo0t déterminé à retrouver son meilleur niveau, FUT pourrait bien devenir l’une des équipes à surveiller dès le Kickoff de Berlin, prévu en janvier prochain.

A NEW ERA BEGINS. @WootVL is officially joining our VCT roster! Welcome to the family, let’s make history together! pic.twitter.com/WNaFn3DKI7

title: Is Vidit Gujrathi Joining TAG? Why Team Apex Gaming’s ‘National Treasure’ Chess Teaser Points to Him
content:
Team Apex Gaming are preparing their first move into chess, and almost everything about the teaser points to Vidit Gujrathi. On 7 November, the Indian organisation founded by Jonathan posted a 33-second video on X captioned “THE NATIONAL TREASURE HAS A NEW HOME!”, alongside a chess piece emoji and its #TAGonTOP hashtag.

TAG has not named the player, and Vidit has not commented publicly. Among India’s best-known grandmasters, however, he fits the brief more closely than anyone else, and he is not known to be signed to an esports organisation.

THE NATIONAL TREASURE HAS A NEW HOME ! #TAGonTOP pic.twitter.com/cQJHAgSaHX

The video is built to give nothing away. It cuts between a wooden chessboard, close-ups of a hand holding a piece, a ring and a wristwatch, before fading to black without a face or a name. The Kick logo in the corner is not a clue in itself, because Kick has been TAG’s official live-streaming sponsor since September and appears across its content. Fans settled on Vidit almost immediately, and his account was tagged repeatedly in the replies as the post climbed towards 40,000 views.

On results alone, Vidit has one of the strongest records of any Indian player of his generation. He earned the grandmaster title in 2013 and won the FIDE Grand Swiss in 2023, which took him to the 2024 Candidates Tournament in Toronto. There, he beat Hikaru Nakamura in both of their games, shortly after reaching a career-high rating of 2747 and a world ranking of 14th. He has also won two Olympiad gold medals with India, captaining the team to a shared title online in 2020 before winning again in Budapest in 2024.

His appeal to an organisation like TAG goes well beyond the board, though. Vidit has built one of the biggest audiences in Indian chess through his streams and YouTube videos, which makes him a natural fit for a team that grew out of Jonathan’s own creator brand. His FIDE profile now lists a standard rating of 2693, but his public profile has kept growing, helped by a newer side of his career. His X bio now reads “Now also building AI things”, and NVIDIA sent him early access to its RTX Spark this week.

title: IEM Beijing 2026 Grand Finals Set After High-Stakes Semi-Finals
content:
The Grand Finals of the IEM Beijing 2026 are set after two action-packed semi-final clashes. MongolZ secured a dominant win against NAVI to open the semi-finals, followed by an impressive display by MOUZ to send BETBOOM home. With a million on the line, here is how the semi-finals set up the interesting clash:

. @1mongolz make quick work of @natusvincere and book their spot in the GRAND FINAL of #IEM Beijing 2026! Cache 13-10 Inferno 13-11 pic.twitter.com/uspxdDsuV5

The Asian side’s pistol-round win earned them a 3-0 start before NAVI could hit the board. The first round gave them some dominance in the middle of the half, only for MongolZ to walk away with a big lead by converting the final few rounds. Swapping sides with a 4-round deficit, NAVI took the lead for the first time on the map, winning five in a row on their offence before MongolZ could find their footing. Shuffling their defence and taking a more proactive approach following a timeout, MongolZ managed to effortlessly close out the map, winning 4 out of the final 5 rounds of Cache. Winning their opponents’ pick with a 13-10 scoreline, MongolZ took the lead in the series, with blitZ topping the charts with 24 kills and 1.71 IR.

Having lost their opponents’ pick, NAVI saw MongolZ convert their second-round force after winning the pistol. Building off it, they pulled in 5 rounds in the first half to make the map competitive as NAVI remained dominant for the better part of the half. Swapping sides, MongolZ pulled in 5 rounds in a row to take the lead in the map before the NAVI offence started converting rounds. Despite taking the lead, MongolZ managed to secure the final three rounds of the half as they narrowly secured Inferno with a 13-11 win. Going all the way for 24 rounds, Wonderful’s heroics fell short against a brilliant display of teamwork by MongolZ as they booked their place in the Grand Finals.

. @mousesports quickly defeat @BetBoomTeam to secure their spot in the #IEM Beijing 2026 GRAND FINAL Ancient 13-7 Mirage 13-8 pic.twitter.com/7LSURhNxul

The solid 4-0 lead for BETBOOM to start the game saw the scoreline get levelled as MOUZ won four rounds of their own. Closing the half with three-round streaks, MOUZ edged out a 7-5 lead as they built on the solid start of the offence. With BETBOOM struggling on the defence, MOUZ used the opportunity to cruise past the CIS side and secure an opening map with a convincing 13-7 scoreline.

title: Greensboro Police Say GTA 6 Needs to Hurry Up So ‘Y’all Can Stay at Home’ and Officers Get a Break
content:
The Greensboro Police Department in North Carolina has become the latest unlikely voice in the countdown to Grand Theft Auto VI. “GTA 6 needs to hurry up and get here so y’all can stay at home and let us catch a break,” the department posted on X on the afternoon of 6 November. Within a day, the post had passed 600,000 views, 25,000 likes and 2,000 reposts, making it one of the most shared reactions to the game’s arrival so far. The post itself had no image or link, just a single line of text.

Rockstar Games releases GTA VI on 19 November, less than two weeks after the post went up.

GTA 6 needs to hurry up and get here so y'all can stay at home and let us catch a break.

The joke landed because it flips the usual conversation around a series built on car chases, heists and running from the police. Several of the most widely shared quote posts simply pointed out the irony of an official police account counting down to a Grand Theft Auto game. Others called it the tweet of the night, while one local user replied with delight that it was their own police department. Rockstar had not responded to the post publicly by Saturday.

The GTA joke is not a one-off for the account. Greensboro police have built a large following with a deliberately casual, comedic tone, led by public information coordinator Patrick DeSota. According to The Assembly, DeSota has a background in radio and has run the department’s social media for around two years. In February, Carolina Journal reported that some of the department’s top posts on X had drawn millions of views and more than 50,000 likes each. DeSota told the outlet that the approach was “a good way for us to connect with the community”.

The style has even turned into merchandise that has sold well beyond North Carolina. A Facebook post telling residents to “drink some choccy milk, have a little snacky snack and don’t crime” became a T-shirt in October 2025. The first 250 shirts sold out within an hour, according to Officer.com. A further 750 sold out within 48 hours, with orders arriving from as far away as New Zealand and Britain. The proceeds went to the Greensboro Police Foundation , a nonprofit that buys equipment for the department.

title: Kai Cenat’s GTA Marathon Sets Go Viral as an Unconfirmed $450K Price Tag Revives Questions About His Nigeria School
content:
Kai Cenat is playing his way through the Grand Theft Auto series on Twitch, and the sets he has built for it have become almost as big a talking point as the games. The streamer went live on 5 November with a simple promise, posting on X that he was “PLAYING EVERY GTA UNTIL I BEAT IT”. Each new game has come with its own real-life set, from a garage inspired by GTA III to a neon hotel front for Vice City. Viral posts on X have since claimed the setup cost $450,000, a figure Kai Cenat has not confirmed, and that claim has pulled his school project in Nigeria back into the conversation.

PLAYING GTA 3, VICE CITY, SAN ADREAS, 4 & 5 ALL ON STREAM NOVEMBER 5TH 3PM EST pic.twitter.com/eB3be9yqmr

He first announced the marathon on 2 November, writing that he would play “GTA 3, VICE CITY, SAN ADREAS, 4 & 5 ALL ON STREAM” from 3pm Eastern Time on 5 November. A few minutes later, he followed up with a single word, “Andreas”, to fix the spelling. The timing is deliberate, because the run ends with Grand Theft Auto V just as the new game arrives. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and our GTA 6 release date guide has the full launch details.

The stream started with GTA III, and Kai Cenat spent a little under ten hours on it before moving on, according to the Twitch statistics site TwitchTracker. He then switched to Vice City in the early hours of 6 November, Eastern Time, and played it for more than 18 hours. San Andreas followed on the evening of 6 November in New York, and it was still running on his Twitch channel on Saturday. By then, the broadcast had passed 39 hours without a break in the stream itself.

The numbers have been steady rather than record-breaking for a creator of his size. TwitchTracker puts his average audience at around 31,600 viewers across the whole stream, with a peak of 46,812 concurrent viewers during San Andreas. The broadcast had also passed 1.2 million hours watched and gained more than 19,000 new followers. Those figures are a long way below his subathons, but he was also the first streamer to pass one million active Twitch subscribers, during Mafiathon 3 in September 2025.

Each switch between games has also brought a new set and a new outfit. For GTA III, he posed in a leather jacket and combat trousers with a baseball bat, in front of a garage front signed “8-Ball’s Autos” and a poster of the game’s cover. For Vice City, he swapped to a palm-print shirt in front of a neon-lit hotel facade lined with palm trees. San Andreas brought a white vest, a green bandana and a BMX bike on a set built around a Grove Street graffiti wall.

title: FACEIT Opens Community Vote on Eliminating the CS2 Knife Round
content:
The FACEIT knife round vote lets Counter-Strike 2 players decide whether the pre-match knife fight stays in matchmaking. FACEIT announced the vote on X. Players can choose to keep the knife round or switch to random starting sides. The winning option will be tested at the start of FACEIT Season 10 on December 9. Voting closes on November 12, 2026.

This article covers how the current system works, what changes if the knife round goes, when the test starts, and which leagues are not affected.

FACEIT has opened a community vote on the knife round in its Counter-Strike 2 matchmaking. Players can vote to keep it or remove it. If FACEIT removes the knife round, the game will pick starting sides at random.

Right now, both teams play a knife round before the match. The winning team chooses whether to start on the T side or the CT side. The team captain makes that choice in chat.

FACEIT announced the vote in a post on X . The option with the most votes will be tested at the start of FACEIT Season 10 on December 9, 2026. Voting closes on November 12, 2026.

Announcing the knife round vote, where you decide whether we keep the knife round or pick sides at random. The winning option goes live as a test in Season 10 on December 09. Vote by November 12 https://t.co/WywDprRVmT pic.twitter.com/i5o3DVIDGA

title: Faker prévient Bilibili Gaming : « C’est dommage pour eux de tomber sur T1 »
content:
T1 est encore au rendez-vous. Triple championne du monde en titre, la formation coréenne a décroché sa dixième qualification consécutive en demi-finale des Worlds en venant à bout de la Karmine Corp. Malgré une troisième manche concédée aux Français, Faker et ses coéquipiers ont globalement maîtrisé leur sujet, notamment grâce aux performances exceptionnelles de Peyz. Interrogé après la rencontre, le légendaire midlaner s’est montré particulièrement satisfait de la prestation collective de son équipe. « Aujourd’hui, avant toute chose, je trouve que notre travail d’équipe lors des teamfights était vraiment au point et je pense que nous avons pu dérouler la partie comme nous l’avions prévu » , a-t-il expliqué en interview.

Un succès qui semble avoir parfaitement lancé T1 dans cette phase finale. Alors qu’il avait regretté le manque d’adversité rencontré durant le Swiss Stage, Faker a cette fois apprécié l’intensité des affrontements face à la KC. « Aujourd’hui, il y a eu beaucoup de teamfights croustillants, donc je suis plutôt content. J’espère que nous aurons un autre affrontement explosif en demi-finale. » Une perspective qui devrait ravir les spectateurs, puisque le prochain adversaire des Coréens n’est autre que Bilibili Gaming, l’un des grands prétendants au titre mondial.

Après avoir éliminé Hanwha Life lors du Swiss Stage, puis balayé Dplus KIA en quarts de finale (3-0), Bilibili Gaming poursuit son impressionnante campagne contre les représentants de la LCK. La formation chinoise espère désormais ajouter T1 à son tableau de chasse et se rapprocher d’un premier sacre mondial. Mais Faker ne semble pas particulièrement inquiet à l’idée de retrouver les coéquipiers de Knight. Au contraire, le joueur de 30 ans leur a adressé un avertissement aussi respectueux que provocateur.

« BLG a affiché un niveau de jeu solide, de très fortes performances tout au long des Worlds cette année. Je pense qu’ils ont ce qu’il faut pour remporter le tournoi. Mais c’est dommage pour eux de tomber sur T1 en demi-finale » , a lancé Faker avec une confiance déconcertante. Une déclaration qui donne le ton avant ce choc entre deux des meilleures équipes de la planète. Bilibili Gaming rêve de faire tomber un troisième représentant coréen, mais T1 compte bien poursuivre sa quête d’un quatrième titre mondial consécutif. Rendez-vous ce dimanche pour découvrir qui aura le dernier mot.

A WORLDS 2024 FINALS REMATCH: BLG versus T1 in the #Worlds2026 Semifinals! pic.twitter.com/Bo3wxzymeZ

title: GodLike Are Back in Valorant: RvK, azys and sayoo Reportedly Lead Roster for VCT 2027 Open Qualifiers
content:
GodLike Esports are reportedly preparing a return to Valorant, with a roster of five experienced South Asian Challengers players for the VCT 2027 Kickoff Open Qualifiers. The line-up was leaked on X on 7 November by Valorant community figure Purab Jyoti Kashyap, who listed Rishi “RvK” Vijayakumar, Azis “azys” Nandang, Willy “sayoo” Ivandra, Kasif “Paradox” Sayyed and Norbu “Karam1l” Tsering.

GodLike have not announced the roster, and none of the five players has publicly confirmed the move. If the report is accurate, it would be the Indian organisation’s third attempt at building a Valorant team, after short-lived rosters in 2021 and 2023.

[LEAK] Godlike Valorant Roster for VCT OQ South Asia – RvK – Azys – Sayoo – Paradox – Karam1l An experienced and well-balanced roster on paper, but I was really hoping to see a new face. Thoughts? pic.twitter.com/su7d6OCBT8

Kashyap described the group as “an experienced and well-balanced roster on paper”, although he added that he had been hoping to see a new face. That reaction sums up the line-up fairly well. Three of the five players are Indian, while azys is Filipino and sayoo is Indonesian, and all five have spent years on the South Asian Challengers circuit. Several of them have also played together before, which could matter with the Open Qualifiers now only ten days away.

RvK is the most decorated name on the list, with a long record of trophies in the region. He won both 2023 Challengers League South Asia splits with Orangutan, with azys alongside him, before spells at Reckoning Esports, True Rippers and DOT EXE. He then joined S8UL Esports in March 2026, winning the Challengers 2026 South Asia Split 1 Final Stage and finishing second in the Split 2 Playoffs. That runner-up finish came behind sayoo’s No Salary Peek, who won the Split 2 title and later finished fourth at the Challengers 2026 Pacific Last Chance Qualifier.

azys has an even longer list of titles in South Asia, despite spending this year away from the region. After his Orangutan years, he won the Challengers League 2024 South Asia Split 3 Final Stage with Mogo eSports, and then took Challengers 2025 South Asia Stage 2 with Revenant XSpark. He moved to Xipto Esports in Southeast Asia for 2026. The Indonesian sayoo made his name at home, where he won Challengers League Indonesia Split 1 with Bigetron Arctic and reached the 2023 SEA Games final with the national team.

title: Wardogs Season 3 Release Date Revealed: New Map, Improved Anti-Cheat, and More
content:
Despite starting off strong with an incredibly successful first season, Bulkhead’s all-out tactical warfare title Wardogs didn’t exactly have the smoothest Season 2. From a failed “ Lonestar Needs You ” campaign to changes that effectively killed cross-region gameplay for many players, Season 2 of Wardogs saw the devs make multiple missteps, which was promptly reflected in the game’s player numbers on Steam.

Fortunately, the devs behind Wardogs have been pretty vocal about addressing their mistakes. According to a dev log shared by Bulkhead on November 6th, a good portion of the missteps in Season 2 were caused by giving in to player complaints too quickly.

“Both we, the developers, and you, as the players, must hold strong and not speedrun fixes to appease the loudest voices,” the devs said. “The perfect example of what happens if you react too quickly is Season 2.”

Alongside addressing the past mistakes, Bulkhead finally shed light on the release date for Wardogs Season 3 via the dev log, while also confirming some of the changes the game will be getting with its next major update.

Bulkhead has confirmed that the highly anticipated Wardogs Season 3 will go live on November 12, 2026 , and it will bring with it a number of crucial changes to the title, aimed at fixing some of the damage caused by the past season.

WARDOGS Season 03 drops November 12th. New map. Longer seasons. Renewed convictions. DEVLOG below. Patch Notes next week. pic.twitter.com/DMqGFsSThA

title: GameMill Is Pulling Avatar The Last Airbender: Quest for Balance From Sale as Its Licence Ends
content:
GameMill Entertainment is pulling Avatar: The Last Airbender: Quest for Balance from sale at the end of December 2026, a little more than three years after the game first launched. The publisher explained the decision in a notice on the game’s Steam store page, which was first reported on 5 November. It said the game is “soon to be leaving Steam at the end of December 2026 as our licensing agreement for the title has concluded”. GameMill also told existing owners that the game “will remain in your library and will continue to be fully playable”. The news has since sent searches for GameMill’s Xbox delistings climbing in the United States, as players try to work out which versions are affected.

So far, GameMill’s notice only covers the Steam version of the game. On the Xbox Store , Quest for Balance was still on sale for $49.99 on 7 November, with no warning about its removal on the listing. GameMill has not published separate dates for the Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo Switch versions either. Because the reason given is the end of the licence itself, however, the console versions are widely expected to follow the PC release off digital stores.

That is exactly what happened with GameMill’s two Street Outlaws games, whose removal from every major storefront was confirmed at the end of October. Quest for Balance has never been part of Game Pass, unlike the games in this month’s first Game Pass wave , so buying it outright is the only way to play it on Xbox. The store does list it as cloud playable for members of Game Pass, whose pricing Microsoft is currently testing , but only for players who already own the game.

Physical copies are not affected by digital delistings, and the game was released on disc for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X and Nintendo Switch. Those versions should keep working as normal, although retailers may struggle to restock them once the licence has run out. GameMill has not said whether the game’s online co-op mode will change, and its notice only promises that the game will stay fully playable for owners.

Quest for Balance was developed by Bamtang Games and released on 22 September 2023 for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and PC. It retells the story of the original Nickelodeon series across 18 replayable chapters, with nine playable characters including Aang, Katara, Sokka and Toph. Players can tackle it alone or in two-player co-op, using all four elements to solve puzzles and fight off Fire Nation soldiers. GameMill pitched it as a game made “with family play in mind” when it announced the release date in August 2023.

Reception, however, was poor from the very start. When the game was revealed in 2023, some fans compared its look to a PlayStation 2 game, according to the Spanish outlet LevelUp. Its Steam page now shows a “Mostly Negative” rating, with only 38% of 155 user reviews recommending it. The game never collected enough critic reviews for a Metacritic score, and it was still listed at its full price of $49.99 on Steam this week.

title: R6 Siege X ranks explained: All 40 ranks and how Ranked 3.0 works
content:
Rainbow Six Siege X (R6 Siege X) has eight ranks, from Copper to Champion, with five divisions each for 40 total. Ranked 3.0 reworked the system in 2026, abolishing hidden MMR and adding placement matches.

Ranked runs from Copper to Champion . Each Tier has five divisions, running from V to I. Champion now includes five divisions, matching the rest of the Ranked ladder.

Ranked is also gated behind account level 50.

Ubisoft launched Ranked 3.0 with Operation System Override on June 2, 2026. The biggest change is that hidden MMR, a behind-the-scenes matchmaking rating, is gone. Your visible rank now reflects your skill, and matchmaking uses just your Rank Points (RP).

You progress through the ranked ladder through games. On average, each win grants 30 RP .

KDA does not factor into rank. Ubisoft argued that support, intel gathering, and flank watch matter as much as eliminations but are largely unquantifiable and don’t show up on the match report.

title: LEC : Jopa fait patienter Vitality
content:
Le mercato des ADC s’annonce particulièrement mouvementé en Europe. Alors que plusieurs joueurs majeurs, dont Upset, Supa et Carzzy, arrivent en fin de contrat, Josip « Jopa » Čančar fait partie des profils les plus convoités. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , le Croate de 23 ans aurait notamment reçu une proposition de Vitality pour la saison 2027. Mais l’ancien joueur de SK Gaming n’aurait pas encore donné sa réponse, préférant attendre de voir si d’autres opportunités se présentent. Plusieurs formations du LEC auraient déjà entamé des discussions avec lui, et Jopa espérerait notamment décrocher une place dans une équipe mieux armée pour jouer les premiers rôles.

Il faut dire que sa cote a considérablement grimpé après une première saison convaincante au plus haut niveau européen. Malgré les difficultés de SK Gaming, qui n’a atteint les playoffs d’aucun des trois splits en 2026, Jopa a régulièrement tiré son épingle du jeu aux côtés de Mikyx. Ses performances individuelles lui ont notamment permis de terminer deuxième du vote pour le titre de Rookie of the Year, confirmant son statut de jeune talent prometteur. Son départ de SK semble désormais inévitable, puisque l’organisation allemande aurait déjà trouvé un accord verbal avec le Français 3XA pour lui succéder.

Du côté de Vitality, l’arrivée de Jopa pourrait entraîner un changement majeur sur la botlane. Si le Croate acceptait l’offre des Abeilles, il prendrait la place de Carzzy, présent dans l’effectif depuis trois saisons consécutives. Un retour dans une structure qu’il connaît déjà bien, puisqu’il avait évolué au sein de l’équipe académique en LFL entre 2024 et 2025, notamment aux côtés de Naak Nako. Mais les dirigeants français ne misent pas tout sur cette piste et auraient également étudié les profils d’Upset, Harpoon ou encore Looki.

Cette incertitude illustre parfaitement la situation actuelle du marché des AD Carry en LEC. Plusieurs organisations attendraient de finaliser leurs recrutements au poste de support avant de choisir leur tireur, tandis que certaines exploreraient également des pistes en Corée du Sud et en Amérique du Nord. Vitality, de son côté, prépare une refonte importante de son effectif, avec notamment les arrivées attendues de Reha et Wadi à la tête du staff technique, en remplacement de Pad, annoncé chez G2 Esports. Pour Jopa, la patience pourrait donc être payante, mais elle laisse pour l’instant les Abeilles dans l’attente. Reste à savoir si le projet français saura le convaincre, ou si une autre formation européenne parviendra à lui offrir le défi qu’il recherche.

title: G2 Part Ways With League of Legends Coach Perkz, Who Then Deletes His X Account
content:
G2 Esports ended Perkz's run as League of Legends head coach after his X statement, and he has since deleted the account.

G2 Esports has ended its collaboration with head coach Luka "Perkz" Perković and will not announce any staff or roster changes until free agency officially opens, Sheep Esports reported.

Perkz has since deleted his X account, Dexerto reported.

The decision came on Thursday, November 5, a few hours after Perkz, a former midlaner and team captain, published a long statement on X. It covered his career, his appointment as G2's head coach and the team's disappointing 2026 Worlds run.

The League of Legends team now heads into the offseason without a coach.

Dexerto put the statement at 2,676 words, posted on November 4. Perkz described it as his first and last honest post, according to the outlet.

title: LEC : Fnatic risque aussi de perdre Vladi…
content:
Rien ne va plus chez Fnatic. Après une année 2026 à oublier, marquée par des résultats décevants et une absence aux Worlds, l’organisation londonienne s’apprête à vivre une intersaison particulièrement agitée. Selon les informations du média espagnol Esportmaníacos , le midlaner grec Vladimiros « Vladi » Kourtidis aurait décidé d’étudier les différentes possibilités qui s’offrent à lui sur le marché des transferts. Une situation délicate pour Fnatic, qui souhaiterait pourtant prolonger son joueur et en faire l’un des piliers de son nouveau projet. Pour l’instant, aucun départ n’est acté, mais le Grec serait à l’écoute des propositions d’autres équipes du LEC.

Il faut dire que la saison écoulée a laissé des traces. Huitième du LEC Versus, Fnatic a ensuite terminé les Spring et Summer Splits à la septième place, sans parvenir à se qualifier pour les playoffs. Malgré l’arrivée de Soboro sur la toplane en cours d’année, les hommes de GrabbZ n’ont jamais trouvé la bonne formule. Une série de contre-performances qui a poussé la direction à annoncer une profonde restructuration de son département League of Legends, avec notamment le recrutement prévu d’un nouveau directeur général basé à Berlin.

Le possible départ de Vladi viendrait s’ajouter à une liste déjà bien remplie. Razork, figure emblématique de Fnatic ces dernières saisons, serait en passe de rejoindre Team Heretics, tandis que le support coréen Lospa a trouvé un accord verbal avec SK Gaming. Deux mouvements importants qui pourraient laisser la formation britannique avec plusieurs postes à reconstruire avant le début de la saison 2027.

Pour remplacer Lospa, Fnatic aurait notamment manifesté son intérêt pour Labrov, dont le contrat avec G2 Esports arrive à expiration. Mais le dossier s’annonce compliqué, les Samouraïs souhaitant absolument conserver leur support grec, également courtisé par NAVI. Dans ce contexte, perdre Vladi représenterait un nouveau coup dur pour une organisation déjà en pleine crise sportive. Reste à savoir si les dirigeants parviendront à convaincre leur midlaner de participer à la reconstruction, ou si Fnatic devra repartir sur des bases presque entièrement nouvelles en 2027.

title: Missing Utah Teen Rescued After Asking for Help Through an Among Us Player
content:
A 17-year-old girl who went missing from Utah in May 2025 has been rescued from a home in Oregon after she reached out for help through a player she met in Among Us. The FBI recovered her on November 1, 2026, and an Oregon man, Adam Hunter Harmel, 39, has been charged in federal court.

According to the charges, Harmel transported the girl, who was 15 when she disappeared, across state lines with the intent to engage in criminal sexual activity. She was held at his home in Huntington, Oregon, for around 18 months. Harmel has been charged, not convicted, and the allegations have not been proven in court.

According to reports, the girl had been given a phone with no mobile service that could still connect to Wi-Fi. In mid-October, she began talking to another young player through Among Us. Their conversation later moved to a different social media app, where she told them who she was and that she was being held against her will. Reports say she believed police had stopped looking for her.

The other player’s mother contacted the FBI. On November 1, investigators monitored a video call in which the girl described what was happening and confirmed where she was, according to KSL . She was recovered from the property the same day and taken for medical care. Harmel was arrested during a traffic stop.

The case was investigated by FBI Salt Lake City and the Rich County Sheriff’s Office, which had been working on it for more than a year. According to a Department of Justice statement, Harmel has been charged with transporting a minor across state lines with the intent to engage in criminal sexual activity. He made his first appearance in federal court on November 4.

“We are grateful she can return home, and we will continue working with our partners to hold those responsible accountable,” FBI Director Kash Patel said, as reported by KSL.

title: Does Marvel Rivals have crossplay? Answered
content:
Many multiplayer games have crossplay these days, and Marvel Rivals is no exception. Here’s everything to know about crossplay and cross-progression in NetEase Games’ hero shooter.

Yes, Marvel Rivals has crossplay in its casual game modes for PC, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Xbox Series X|S. However, not all of these platforms are put into one player pool when it comes to ranked matches.

That is, folks on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Xbox Series X|S can duke it out alongside each other. Meanwhile, those on PC can only face other PC players.

In terms of a cross-progression feature, Marvel Rivals has this as well. However, there are a few caveats. You can sign in on different platforms and use the same character. The supported platforms are currently PC via Epic, Steam, and Loading Bay plus PlayStation, and Xbox. However, if you have characters on multiple accounts, then you must choose a primary character.

“Unselected characters are stored and can be restored if you change your primary character after the cooldown,” according to NetEase Games. “Or if you unlink the account. Data between characters is not merged.”

It’s also worth noting that ranked progress, leaderboard standings, and battle data are tracked separately for PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. It’s the same for platform-exclusive skins.

title: Miami Heat Reveal Limited-Edition GTA 6 Jerseys: How to Get One

The game tips off at 7 PM ET, which is 5:30 AM IST on November 19, and will be shown nationally on ESPN. A few hours later, GTA 6 goes live around the world.

The Heat have made two different jerseys, and they are not the same. The one the players wear is toned down to fit NBA branding rules. The one you can buy goes much further into GTA 6.

Both come with matching shorts. The colours also line up with the Travis Scott x Nike Air Force 1 sneakers that were released earlier, so the whole collection works as one set.

Right now, there is only one confirmed way. The limited-edition jerseys go on sale at Kaseya Center on the night of November 18. The Heat have not announced an online sale or a price for the jersey, and stock is limited, so fans at the arena are likely to get first pick.

If you cannot make it to Miami, the rest of the Vice City collection is easier to find. title: PS Plus Perks: Every Offer in the Launch Lineup and How to Claim Them
content:
PlayStation Plus now comes with perks beyond games. From November 6, 2026, subscribers on any PS Plus tier can unlock eight partner offers, including a three-month YouTube Premium trial, 20% off DAZN Ultimate and money off PS5 consoles and DualSense controllers. There is a catch, though: for now, the perks are only available to PSN accounts registered in the UK, France and Germany.

PlayStation says it will add more offers through the year. Here is the full launch lineup and how to claim it.

Every perk is available on Essential, Extra and Premium, so you do not need the most expensive tier to use them. Each one has its own end date, and some are only for new customers of the partner service.

The DAZN deal is the stand-out for sports fans, because unlike most of the list, it also works for people who already pay for DAZN. The Sony Electronics discount has the shortest window, ending on December 31, so it is the one to use first if you have been eyeing a new headset.

Claiming is simple. Go to the PS Plus page on PlayStation’s UK website and sign in with the PSN account that holds your subscription. Pick the perk you want, select “Unlock Offer” and follow the steps on the partner’s site.

You need an active PS Plus subscription to see the offers, and your PSN account has to be registered in the UK, France or Germany. If your subscription lapses, you lose access to any perks you have not claimed yet.

title: For the pro: Jeffrey Chau on how Razer champions reliability in esports
content:
When an esports tournament experiences technical difficulties, it can undermine competitive integrity. In an exclusive interview with esports.gg, Razer global esports director Jeffrey Chau talked about the importance of hardware reliability and how having the right technology can mitigate issues.

In his interview with esports.gg, Chau noted how the use of magnets and metal desks affected VALORANT Champions Tour (VCT) Shanghai 2026. According to Riot Games , interference from the tournament’s custom metal desks prompted players to switch to wired connections.

“If there’s something interfering with their gear, they can sense it,” Chau said, sympathizing with FUT Esports and Doğan “xeus” Gözgen . “They can sense every millisecond and every slight adjustment. If anything kind of varies from what they’re used to, they will sense it right away. So if there’s any interference, they will start to feel it as they’re playing.”

He continued, adding that in esports, reliability is everything. Players train with specific chairs, tables, and equipment, so maintaining a consistent setup on stage is important.

“So for Razer and our technology, we really, really focus on reliability,” he said.

One of the ways Chau’s team achieves reliability is through the Razer Analog Optical Switches , which use light-based actuation for keyboards. Unlike Hall Effect switches, they are not susceptible to interference from nearby magnetic sources.

title: Could Microsoft Sell Xbox? Analyst Links Its Future to the US Midterms
content:
Microsoft could sell Xbox, according to games industry analyst Joost van Dreunen. In a Substack post published on November 5 , titled “The Election That Could Break Up”, he argues that the results of the 2026 US midterm elections may speed up a spin-off or sale of Microsoft’s gaming business.

It is a prediction, not a plan. Microsoft has not said it wants to sell Xbox, and Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has said publicly that “Xbox is not for sale.” Even so, the argument is worth looking at, because it ties Xbox’s future to something much bigger than games: Microsoft’s spending on AI.

Van Dreunen points to Democrats winning control of Congress in the midterms as his starting point. His argument, as summarised by Beebom, is that the result could make Microsoft’s AI expansion harder, and that Xbox could end up paying for it.

Data centres are the link. AI needs huge amounts of computing power, and local opposition to new data centre projects is growing in the US. A Wall Street Journal report cited by Beebom found that more than 40 towns and counties had discussed limits on data centre construction, and at least 10 had voted to restrict or ban new projects. If building that infrastructure gets harder or slower, Microsoft may look for other ways to free up money and focus.

This is where Xbox comes in. According to the figures Beebom reports, Xbox content and services brought in $5.4 billion in the latest quarter, down 2% year on year. Over a comparable period, Microsoft’s search and advertising business grew from $5.9 billion to $6.6 billion.

A business that is shrinking inside a company betting everything on AI is an obvious candidate for a rethink. Van Dreunen himself is careful with his wording. In the public part of his post, he writes that the election “may accelerate several trends that are already reshaping the business”, rather than changing the economics of gaming outright.

BIG débarque en RLCS
content:
Le mercato continue de s’agiter sur Rocket League, et cette fois, c’est un nouveau géant de l’esport allemand qui pourrait entrer dans la danse. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , BIG serait sur le point de recruter Damian « Tox » Schäfer, Matheo « osaft » Hapke et Nico « Nico » Majgren, trois joueurs libres ayant annoncé leur association le 23 octobre dernier. Une arrivée historique pour l’organisation berlinoise, fondée en 2017 et particulièrement connue pour ses équipes sur Counter-Strike et League of Legends. BIG a également connu le succès sur Fortnite, avec notamment un sacre à l’Esports World Cup, et souhaiterait désormais étendre ses activités à Rocket League.

Pour ses premiers pas sur la scène compétitive, BIG miserait sur un mélange d’expérience et de jeunesse. Présent en RLCS depuis 2020, Tox apporterait son vécu au groupe, après avoir notamment terminé deuxième des qualifications européennes de la dernière chance pour les Worlds 2026 avec Volare. À ses côtés, le Danois Nico, âgé de 17 ans, sort d’une saison encourageante chez NOVO Esports, tandis que son homologue allemand osaft, également âgé de 17 ans, s’est illustré sur la scène du 1v1. Demi-finaliste de l’European 1v1 Open en 2026, ce dernier avait notamment remporté le championnat d’Europe FIFAe avec Tox sous les couleurs de l’Allemagne. Le trio serait accompagné de l’entraîneur norvégien Kasper « Kasper » Sjølstad, ancien membre de WYLDE.

Cette nouvelle formation devrait rapidement avoir l’occasion de se mesurer aux meilleures équipes européennes. Le trio figure parmi les candidats les plus sérieux aux qualifications ouvertes du London Club Kick-Off, aux côtés notamment de Geekay Esports et d’Ikkaku, la nouvelle équipe formée par Rezears, yujin et le Français ExoTiiK. Un premier rendez-vous important pour BIG, qui ne fait pas partie des 20 organisations invitées à intégrer le programme de partenariat des RLCS 2027.

L’organisation allemande aurait d’ailleurs dû faire face à une concurrence importante pour s’attacher les services du trio. Toujours selon la même source, l’Eintracht Francfort, également présent sur League of Legends, aurait tenté sa chance, tout comme Five Fears et NOVO Esports. BIG semble finalement avoir pris l’avantage dans ce dossier, même si aucune signature n’a encore été officialisée. Avec un vétéran expérimenté et deux jeunes talents prometteurs, la structure berlinoise pourrait rapidement se faire une place parmi les outsiders de la scène européenne.
